<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">osmium</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">json</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">math</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">random</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">subprocess</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">os</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">sys</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">csv</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">re</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">argparse</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">requests</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">time</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">shutil</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">threading</span>
<span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">numpy</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">np</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">scipy.spatial</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">cKDTree</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">shapely.geometry</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Polygon</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">shapely</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">wkt</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">shapely_wkt</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">pyproj</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">Transformer</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">dotenv</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">load_dotenv</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">concurrent.futures</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">ThreadPoolExecutor</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">as_completed</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">depot.demand</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">DemandData</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">bbox_utils</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">get_bbox</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">special_demand_utils</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">detect_and_confirm_special_demand</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_open_url_detached</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">enrich_utils</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cluster_and_consolidate</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">add_named_special_demand</span><span class="p">,</span>
                          <span class="n">route_new_pops</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">enforce_max_point_size</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">GreenSpaceIndex</span><span class="p">,</span>
                          <span class="n">CLUSTER_MAX_POP_THRESHOLD</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">CLUSTER_BUFFER_METERS</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="kn">from</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">zensus_utils</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="kn">import</span> <span class="n">ZensusPopulationGrid</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">calibrate_residential_capacity</span>

<span class="c1"># 0. Parse CLI args. Only --bbox for now - see bbox_utils.get_bbox: a bbox</span>
<span class="c1"># already saved for this city always wins, this only matters the first time.</span>
<span class="n">_arg_parser</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">argparse</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">ArgumentParser</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">description</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"Generate demand data from OSM buildings + the QZM commuter matrix."</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">_arg_parser</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add_argument</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">"--bbox"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">type</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">default</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">help</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"Initial bounding box as 'min_lon,min_lat,max_lon,max_lat' (e.g. "</span>
         <span class="s2">"copy-pasted from boundingbox.klokantech.com). Only used the first "</span>
         <span class="s2">"time this city has no bbox saved yet."</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">_arg_parser</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add_argument</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="s2">"--autofill-special-demand"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">action</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">argparse</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">BooleanOptionalAction</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">default</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="n">help</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">"Default: on. Auto-estimates a capacity for 'landmark'-tier special "</span>
         <span class="s2">"demand (universities, hospitals, stadiums, museums, zoos) instead "</span>
         <span class="s2">"of opening a browser tab per one and waiting - same as the "</span>
         <span class="s2">"high-volume 'common' types already get, so a plain run just goes "</span>
         <span class="s2">"straight through. You can still hand-edit the JSON afterward for "</span>
         <span class="s2">"specific ones you want a real researched number on. Pass "</span>
         <span class="s2">"--no-autofill-special-demand to go back to the manual "</span>
         <span class="s2">"review-in-browser flow instead (capped at 15 tabs per run)."</span>
<span class="p">)</span>
<span class="c1"># parse_known_args (not parse_args): this module gets imported by other</span>
<span class="c1"># scripts too (e.g. run_demand_pipeline.py imports all()/demand() from</span>
<span class="c1"># here, and defines its own --stage flag), and we don't want an unrelated</span>
<span class="c1"># CLI flag meant for the importing script to blow up with "unrecognized</span>
<span class="c1"># arguments".</span>
<span class="n">_cli_args</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">_arg_parser</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">parse_known_args</span><span class="p">()</span>

<span class="c1"># 1. Load the environment variables first</span>
<span class="n">load_dotenv</span><span class="p">()</span>

<span class="c1"># 2. Get the city code and other required settings with strict fallbacks</span>
<span class="n">CITY_CODE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">getenv</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"CITY_CODE"</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">CITY_CODE</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="k">raise</span> <span class="ne">ValueError</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"CITY_CODE is missing from your .env file!"</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># These all have the same value for every city in this project (same</span>
<span class="c1"># country-wide OSM extract, same national commuter matrix, same local folder</span>
<span class="c1"># layout) - only override in .env if your setup actually differs.</span>
<span class="n">OSMPBF_FILE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">getenv</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OSMPBF"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"germany-latest.osm.pbf"</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">COMMUTERS_CSV_FILE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">getenv</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"CSV"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"QZM_1X1KM.csv"</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">RAW_BASE_DIR</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">getenv</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"RAW_BASE_DIR"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"raw_map_files"</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">OSRM_URL</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">getenv</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OSRM_URL"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"http://localhost:5000"</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># OPL is no longer read from .env - it always follows this exact pattern, so</span>
<span class="c1"># it's derived straight from CITY_CODE instead of being one more thing to set.</span>
<span class="n">OPL_CLEANED_FILE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">CITY_CODE</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lower</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">_cleaned.opl"</span>

<span class="c1"># Sanity-check OSRM_URL's shape early (also used elsewhere, e.g. run_demand_pipeline.py).</span>
<span class="n">_osrm_port_match</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">re</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">search</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">r</span><span class="s2">":(\d+)$"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">OSRM_URL</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">rstrip</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"/"</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">_osrm_port_match</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="k">raise</span> <span class="ne">ValueError</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Could not parse a port number out of OSRM_URL='</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">OSRM_URL</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">'. "</span>
        <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Expected http://localhost:&lt;port&gt;."</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">OSRM_PORT</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">_osrm_port_match</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">group</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">))</span>

<span class="c1"># BBOX is no longer read from .env - it's looked up (or interactively captured</span>
<span class="c1"># and saved) per city code. See bbox_utils.py.</span>
<span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LON</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LAT</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LON</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LAT</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">get_bbox</span><span class="p">(</span>
    <span class="n">CITY_CODE</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">RAW_BASE_DIR</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">bbox_arg</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">_cli_args</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">bbox</span>
<span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># ==========================================</span>
<span class="c1"># CONFIGURATION</span>
<span class="c1"># ==========================================</span>
<span class="n">CITY_RAW_DIR</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">RAW_BASE_DIR</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">/</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">CITY_CODE</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">/"</span>

<span class="c1"># Optional Zensus 2022 100m population grid (see zensus_utils.py's module</span>
<span class="c1"># comment for the download link). Unlike everything else in CITY_RAW_DIR,</span>
<span class="c1"># this file is NATIONWIDE - Destatis publishes one file covering all of</span>
<span class="c1"># Germany, not one per city - so it lives once, directly alongside this</span>
<span class="c1"># script, and gets bbox-filtered per city at load time instead of being</span>
<span class="c1"># duplicated into every city's raw folder. Entirely optional: the pipeline</span>
<span class="c1"># runs exactly as before if the file hasn't been downloaded yet.</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_find_zensus_grid_csv</span><span class="p">():</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Looks for the (shared, nationwide) Zensus 2022 100m population grid CSV</span>
<span class="sd">    directly in this script's own directory. Returns None (not an error) if</span>
<span class="sd">    no matching file exists yet - this is a data-quality refinement, not a</span>
<span class="sd">    requirement to run the pipeline.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="n">script_dir</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dirname</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abspath</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="vm">__file__</span><span class="p">))</span>
    <span class="n">candidates</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">f</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">f</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">listdir</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">script_dir</span><span class="p">)</span>
                  <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lower</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">endswith</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">".csv"</span><span class="p">)</span>
                  <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="s2">"100m"</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lower</span><span class="p">()</span>
                  <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="s2">"zensus"</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lower</span><span class="p">()]</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">candidates</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">candidates</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  [WARNING] Multiple candidate Zensus 100m grid CSVs found in "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"'</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">script_dir</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">' - using '</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">candidates</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">'. Remove the others "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"if that isn't the right file."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">script_dir</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">candidates</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">])</span>

<span class="n">OUTPUT_FILE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">CITY_RAW_DIR</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">demand_data.json"</span>
<span class="n">AIRPORT_GEOJSON</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">CITY_RAW_DIR</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">runways_taxiways.geojson"</span>
<span class="n">CUSTOM_HUBS_JSON</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">CITY_RAW_DIR</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">custom_hubs.json"</span>

<span class="c1"># Checkpoint written by build_base_demand() and read by enrich_demand() -</span>
<span class="c1"># see the "modular pipeline" split below (all()/build_base_demand()/</span>
<span class="c1"># enrich_demand()/demand()). Holds the raw OSM-parsed, QZM-routed points/pops</span>
<span class="c1"># BEFORE clustering/consolidation or named special demand - i.e. everything</span>
<span class="c1"># that's slow to regenerate (OSM parsing, airport snapping, base OSRM</span>
<span class="c1"># routing). OUTPUT_FILE remains the final enriched result either way.</span>
<span class="n">BASE_OUTPUT_FILE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">CITY_RAW_DIR</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">demand_data_base.json"</span>
<span class="c1"># Cache of green-space polygons captured during OSM parsing (see</span>
<span class="c1"># capture_green_space_relations()/_is_green_space() above), so enrich_demand()</span>
<span class="c1"># can rebuild the same GreenSpaceIndex without re-parsing the full cleaned</span>
<span class="c1"># OPL file just to get these back. Written by build_base_demand().</span>
<span class="n">GREEN_SPACE_CACHE_FILE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">CITY_RAW_DIR</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">green_space_cache.json"</span>

<span class="c1"># None of the docker run commands below set --cpus/--cpuset-cpus, so the</span>
<span class="c1"># container already sees every core Docker itself has access to - on native</span>
<span class="c1"># Linux Docker that's the whole host; on Docker Desktop (Mac/Windows) it's</span>
<span class="c1"># whatever's configured under Settings -&gt; Resources -&gt; CPUs, which can be</span>
<span class="c1"># lower than the host's real core count regardless of anything here. OSRM's</span>
<span class="c1"># own tools (extract/partition/customize/routed) default their internal</span>
<span class="c1"># --threads to "every logical CPU visible to the container" when not given</span>
<span class="c1"># explicitly - so this isn't strictly required, just makes the number</span>
<span class="c1"># predictable/explicit instead of implicit. Bumped from 14 to the full 16 -</span>
<span class="c1"># measured throughput during routing (~1815 req/s at 14 threads, ~130/s per</span>
<span class="c1"># thread) suggested a per-thread server ceiling rather than a client</span>
<span class="c1"># concurrency one, so it's worth giving OSRM every core during this phase</span>
<span class="c1"># rather than reserving 2 - see the CPU utilization sampling around the</span>
<span class="c1"># routing loop below for whether that ceiling is actually CPU-bound.</span>
<span class="n">OSRM_THREADS</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">getenv</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OSRM_THREADS"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"16"</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># Two independent dials for "more, smaller hubs" vs "fewer, bigger hubs" -</span>
<span class="c1"># one for RESIDENTIAL (commuter-origin) hubs, one for JOB hubs. Split into</span>
<span class="c1"># two (instead of one shared HUB_SIZE_RATIO) specifically so job-hub</span>
<span class="c1"># fragmentation can be tuned on its own: a line design gets hard to make</span>
<span class="c1"># profitable when commuters are scattered across too many small, separate</span>
<span class="c1"># job destinations - raising JOB_SIZE_RATIO's effective hub size (i.e.</span>
<span class="c1"># lowering JOB_SIZE_RATIO, or raising RES_SIZE_RATIO relative to it)</span>
<span class="c1"># consolidates jobs into fewer, bigger destinations a line can actually</span>
<span class="c1"># target, independent of how granular residential origins stay.</span>
<span class="c1">#</span>
<span class="c1"># RES_SIZE_RATIO=4 in .env for residential hubs roughly 4x smaller (and</span>
<span class="c1"># correspondingly ~4x more numerous) than the defaults below;</span>
<span class="c1"># JOB_SIZE_RATIO=0.5 for job hubs roughly 2x bigger/fewer. 1 (default, for</span>
<span class="c1"># either) reproduces the original shared tuning exactly.</span>
<span class="c1">#</span>
<span class="c1"># Each is applied as TWO different scale factors, not one flat division,</span>
<span class="c1"># because the constants below aren't all the same kind of quantity:</span>
<span class="c1">#   - the SIZE scale (= 1/ratio) divides POPULATION/COUNT caps directly</span>
<span class="c1">#     (max_point_size, agglomerate_small_threshold, cluster_points()'s</span>
<span class="c1">#     pop-count thresholds) - a "4x smaller hub" should hold ~1/4 the</span>
<span class="c1">#     people, so these need a straight 1/ratio.</span>
<span class="c1">#   - the RADIUS scale (= 1/sqrt(ratio)) divides SPATIAL radii/distances</span>
<span class="c1">#     (RES_MERGE_RADIUS, JOB_MERGE_RADIUS, cluster_points()'s buffer_meters,</span>
<span class="c1">#     agglomerate_pops()'s distance thresholds) - these control the AREA</span>
<span class="c1">#     that gets merged into one hub, and area scales with radius^2. Halving</span>
<span class="c1">#     a radius already quarters the buildings caught inside it (for roughly</span>
<span class="c1">#     uniform density), so radii only need to shrink by sqrt(ratio) to</span>
<span class="c1">#     achieve the same ~ratio-times reduction in per-hub population that</span>
<span class="c1">#     the flat caps get directly. Using 1/ratio on radii too would</span>
<span class="c1">#     overshoot to a ratio^2 reduction in practice.</span>
<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_load_size_ratio</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">env_name</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">ratio</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">getenv</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">env_name</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"1"</span><span class="p">))</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">ratio</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">raise</span> <span class="ne">ValueError</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">env_name</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> must be positive, got </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">ratio</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">ratio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mf">1.0</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">ratio</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mf">1.0</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sqrt</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ratio</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">RES_SIZE_RATIO</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_RES_SIZE_SCALE</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_RES_RADIUS_SCALE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">_load_size_ratio</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"RES_SIZE_RATIO"</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">JOB_SIZE_RATIO</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_JOB_SIZE_SCALE</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_JOB_RADIUS_SCALE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">_load_size_ratio</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"JOB_SIZE_RATIO"</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="n">MAX_HUBS_PER_GRID</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">300</span>
<span class="n">MIN_ROUTE_SIZE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">10</span>         
<span class="n">MIN_COMMUTER_THRESHOLD</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">10</span> 

<span class="n">MAX_ROUTES_LIMIT</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">500_000</span>
<span class="n">MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_JOB</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">150</span>   <span class="c1"># Cap on residential hubs pointing to a single job hub</span>

<span class="c1"># Below this many routes, a 100%-failed pass just means "no valid road route</span>
<span class="c1"># exists for this last handful of pairs" (or a one-off timeout) - normal at</span>
<span class="c1"># this scale, not a sign anything is actually wrong. Only warn about a</span>
<span class="c1"># possible container outage when a large batch fails outright.</span>
<span class="n">OUTAGE_WARNING_MIN_QUEUE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">25</span>

<span class="n">RES_MERGE_RADIUS</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mf">0.2</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_RES_RADIUS_SCALE</span>
<span class="n">JOB_MERGE_RADIUS</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mf">0.3</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_JOB_RADIUS_SCALE</span>
<span class="n">AIRPORT_EDGE_SNAP_RADIUS_METERS</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">1000</span>

<span class="c1"># Everything downstream that decides final hub (point) size, scaled by</span>
<span class="c1"># RES_SIZE_RATIO/JOB_SIZE_RATIO respectively - see cluster_and_consolidate()'s</span>
<span class="c1"># call site in enrich_demand() for where these get used. Population caps use</span>
<span class="c1"># the SIZE scale directly; spatial radii/distances use the RADIUS scale - see</span>
<span class="c1"># the ratio comment above for why the two differ.</span>
<span class="c1">#</span>
<span class="c1"># RES_MAX_POINT_SIZE/JOB_MAX_POINT_SIZE: max residents/jobs a single point</span>
<span class="c1"># can hold before enforce_max_point_size() splits it - applied per-point</span>
<span class="c1"># based on whichever of residents/jobs that point actually holds (see</span>
<span class="c1"># enforce_max_point_size()'s docstring in enrich_utils.py).</span>
<span class="n">RES_MAX_POINT_SIZE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">2000</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_RES_SIZE_SCALE</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="n">JOB_MAX_POINT_SIZE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">2000</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_JOB_SIZE_SCALE</span><span class="p">))</span>

<span class="c1"># agglomerate_pops() only ever groups small RESIDENTIAL origin flows (by</span>
<span class="c1"># shared job destination) into new super-origin points - see depot's</span>
<span class="c1"># agglomerate_pops() docstring - so these scale with the residential ratio</span>
<span class="c1"># only, not job.</span>
<span class="n">RES_AGGLOMERATE_SMALL_THRESHOLD</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">100</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_RES_SIZE_SCALE</span><span class="p">))</span>
<span class="n">RES_AGGLOMERATE_DISTANCE_NONCBD</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mf">0.01</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_RES_RADIUS_SCALE</span>
<span class="n">RES_AGGLOMERATE_DISTANCE_CBD</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mf">0.006</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_RES_RADIUS_SCALE</span>

<span class="c1"># depot's own cluster_points() spatially merges points regardless of type in</span>
<span class="c1"># a single pass - to give jobs and residents truly independent tuning here,</span>
<span class="c1"># cluster_and_consolidate() now runs it TWICE (job points only, then</span>
<span class="c1"># residential points only - see enrich_utils.py), once with each of these.</span>
<span class="n">RES_CLUSTER_MAX_POP_THRESHOLD</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">CLUSTER_MAX_POP_THRESHOLD</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_RES_SIZE_SCALE</span>
<span class="n">RES_CLUSTER_BUFFER_METERS</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">CLUSTER_BUFFER_METERS</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_RES_RADIUS_SCALE</span>
<span class="n">JOB_CLUSTER_MAX_POP_THRESHOLD</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">CLUSTER_MAX_POP_THRESHOLD</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_JOB_SIZE_SCALE</span>
<span class="n">JOB_CLUSTER_BUFFER_METERS</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">CLUSTER_BUFFER_METERS</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_JOB_RADIUS_SCALE</span>

<span class="n">SPECIAL_DEMAND_SPLIT</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mf">0.2</span>

<span class="c1"># These are only ever used as relative gravity WEIGHTS to decide which</span>
<span class="c1"># coordinate gets more of a grid cell's real commuter count (see</span>
<span class="c1"># assign_commuters() below, "share = commuters_to_assign * (weight /</span>
<span class="c1"># total_weight)") - the real CSV totals themselves never change. Previously</span>
<span class="c1"># every amenity=*/shop=*/office=* tagged building shared one flat</span>
<span class="c1"># CAPACITY_JOBS=(500,3000) range regardless of type, so a kiosk and an office</span>
<span class="c1"># tower drew from identical odds - split by rough real-world size instead so</span>
<span class="c1"># the weighting (and MAX_HUBS_PER_GRID, which only helps if the underlying</span>
<span class="c1"># weights actually differ) has something real to work with.</span>
<span class="n">CAPACITY_SHOP</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">40</span><span class="p">)</span>          <span class="c1"># shop=* - almost always a small single unit</span>
<span class="n">CAPACITY_OFFICE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">10</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">150</span><span class="p">)</span>      <span class="c1"># office=*</span>
<span class="n">CAPACITY_JOBS</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">50</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">500</span><span class="p">)</span>        <span class="c1"># everything else job-tagged (commercial/</span>
                                  <span class="c1"># industrial/school/hospital/university/</span>
                                  <span class="c1"># civic/government/generic amenity=*)</span>
<span class="n">CAPACITY_APARTMENTS</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">50</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">500</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">CAPACITY_HOUSES</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">20</span><span class="p">)</span>
<span class="n">CAPACITY_HOTEL</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">20</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">200</span><span class="p">)</span>       <span class="c1"># was lumped into CAPACITY_HOUSES - a hotel</span>
                                  <span class="c1"># isn't a single-family house</span>
<span class="n">CAPACITY_YES_WILDCARD</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">5</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">15</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="c1"># building:levels (floor count) is present on ~29% of buildings in the BER</span>
<span class="c1"># extract - when it's there, use it to differentiate a 2-floor shop building</span>
<span class="c1"># from a 20-floor tower of the same tag instead of leaving that to chance.</span>
<span class="c1"># sqrt-dampened so a very tall building doesn't get a literal 20x multiplier</span>
<span class="c1"># (floor plates shrink, not every floor is identical usable space, etc.).</span>
<span class="n">BUILDING_LEVELS_CAP</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">20</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_levels_multiplier</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="n">levels_raw</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'building:levels'</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">levels_raw</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="mf">1.0</span>
    <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">levels</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">levels_raw</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">except</span> <span class="ne">ValueError</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="mf">1.0</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">levels</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="mf">1.0</span>
    <span class="n">levels</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">levels</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">BUILDING_LEVELS_CAP</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sqrt</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">levels</span><span class="p">))</span>

<span class="n">JOB_TAGS</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="s1">'commercial'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'industrial'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'retail'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'office'</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="s1">'school'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'hospital'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'university'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'civic'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'government'</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="n">RESIDENTIAL_TAGS</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
    <span class="s1">'house'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'detached'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'semidetached_house'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'residential'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'terrace'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'bungalow'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'hotel'</span>
<span class="p">}</span>

<span class="n">SPECIAL_AMENITIES</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">'hospital'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'clinic'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'school'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'university'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'college'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'ferry_terminal'</span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="n">SPECIAL_LEISURE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">'park'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'nature_reserve'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'stadium'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'sports_centre'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'water_park'</span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="n">SPECIAL_TOURISM</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">'theme_park'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'zoo'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'aquarium'</span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="n">JOB_INDICATOR_KEYS</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">'amenity'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'shop'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'office'</span><span class="p">}</span>

<span class="c1"># Parks/nature reserves/water parks/national-park boundaries are counted as a</span>
<span class="c1"># base-pipeline "job" hub (via is_special, see SPECIAL_LEISURE/</span>
<span class="c1"># SPECIAL_TOURISM below - footfall/staff for that facility), but they're</span>
<span class="c1"># almost always mapped as a large polygon (way), and using the polygon's raw</span>
<span class="c1"># nodes[0] vertex put the hub at an arbitrary point on the boundary ring -</span>
<span class="c1"># which for a big or oddly-shaped park is still deep inside the green fill on</span>
<span class="c1"># the rendered map ("hubs on greenland"). Stadium/sports_centre are left out</span>
<span class="c1"># of this - those are real addressable buildings, node[0] there is a</span>
<span class="c1"># reasonable building-corner location, not the middle of open green space.</span>
<span class="n">GREEN_SPACE_LEISURE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">'park'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'nature_reserve'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'water_park'</span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="n">GREEN_SPACE_TOURISM</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">'theme_park'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'zoo'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'aquarium'</span><span class="p">}</span>
<span class="c1"># landuse=recreation_ground: added after finding that Tempelhofer Feld (the</span>
<span class="c1"># huge former Berlin airport field that kept getting hubs placed inside it)</span>
<span class="c1"># isn't tagged leisure=park at all - it's landuse=recreation_ground on a</span>
<span class="c1"># multipolygon RELATION. Real OSM tagging is inconsistent about which of</span>
<span class="c1"># leisure=park vs landuse=recreation_ground/village_green a given big green</span>
<span class="c1"># area gets, so recreation_ground needs the same treatment.</span>
<span class="n">GREEN_SPACE_LANDUSE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s1">'recreation_ground'</span><span class="p">}</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_is_green_space</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'leisure'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">GREEN_SPACE_LEISURE</span>
            <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'tourism'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">GREEN_SPACE_TOURISM</span>
            <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'landuse'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">GREEN_SPACE_LANDUSE</span>
            <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'boundary'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'national_park'</span><span class="p">)</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_green_space_edge_location</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">w</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Computes a rough centroid from all of this way's resolved node</span>
<span class="sd">    locations, then pushes the nodes[0] boundary vertex further out along</span>
<span class="sd">    the centroid-&gt;vertex direction, landing just outside the green area</span>
<span class="sd">    (roughly where an entrance or adjacent building would sit) instead of</span>
<span class="sd">    on/inside its own boundary ring. Push distance scales with how far the</span>
<span class="sd">    vertex already sits from the centroid (a rough proxy for the park's own</span>
<span class="sd">    size) so a small pocket park doesn't get flung disproportionately far,</span>
<span class="sd">    and a huge park (Tiergarten-scale) gets pushed further than a token 20m.</span>
<span class="sd">    This is a cheap approximation, not real point-in-polygon geometry - it</span>
<span class="sd">    won't fully clear every concave/oddly-shaped park, but avoids the common</span>
<span class="sd">    case of landing deep inside a large convex-ish green fill.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="n">v_lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">v_lon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">w</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">nodes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">location</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">w</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">nodes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">location</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lon</span>
    <span class="n">centroid_lat</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">location</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lat</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">n</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">w</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">nodes</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">w</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">nodes</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">centroid_lon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">location</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lon</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">n</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">w</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">nodes</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">w</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">nodes</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">lat_scale</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">1</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mi">111_000</span>
    <span class="n">lon_scale</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">1</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">111_000</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">cos</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">radians</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">v_lat</span><span class="p">)),</span> <span class="mf">0.1</span><span class="p">))</span>

    <span class="n">dy_m</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">v_lat</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">centroid_lat</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">lat_scale</span>
    <span class="n">dx_m</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">v_lon</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">centroid_lon</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">lon_scale</span>
    <span class="n">dist_m</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">hypot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dx_m</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">dy_m</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">dist_m</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">v_lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">v_lon</span>  <span class="c1"># degenerate shape - nothing sensible to push toward</span>

    <span class="n">ux</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">uy</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">dx_m</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">dist_m</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">dy_m</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">dist_m</span>
    <span class="n">push_m</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">100.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">20.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">dist_m</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mf">0.15</span><span class="p">))</span>
    <span class="n">out_lat</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">v_lat</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">uy</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">push_m</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">lat_scale</span>
    <span class="n">out_lon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">v_lon</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">ux</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">push_m</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">lon_scale</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">out_lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">out_lon</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">capture_green_space_relations</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cleaned_opl_path</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Dedicated second pass over the cleaned OPL file to capture green-space</span>
<span class="sd">    polygons that OSMHandler.way() can never see: MULTIPOLYGON RELATIONS.</span>
<span class="sd">    Real case that exposed this: Tempelhofer Feld (Berlin) is mapped as a</span>
<span class="sd">    relation (type=multipolygon) with its tags (landuse=recreation_ground)</span>
<span class="sd">    on the RELATION itself - its member ways carry no tags of their own, so</span>
<span class="sd">    they're invisible to way()'s "if len(w.tags) &gt; 0" check no matter what</span>
<span class="sd">    _is_green_space() recognizes. osmium.SimpleHandler has no callback for</span>
<span class="sd">    assembled multipolygon geometry at all; that requires this separate</span>
<span class="sd">    area-assembly pass via osmium.FileProcessor(...).with_areas().</span>

<span class="sd">    Only relation-derived areas are kept (from_way() == False) - polygons</span>
<span class="sd">    for simple closed ways are already captured more cheaply inline by</span>
<span class="sd">    OSMHandler.way()/_capture_green_space_polygon() as they're parsed, so</span>
<span class="sd">    keeping only relations here avoids building every building-as-a-way</span>
<span class="sd">    polygon in the file twice.</span>

<span class="sd">    Handles holes (inner rings) properly via shapely's Polygon(shell,</span>
<span class="sd">    holes) - relevant for parks with excluded buildings/lakes inside their</span>
<span class="sd">    outer boundary.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="kn">import</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">osmium.filter</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">as</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nn">osmium_filter</span>

    <span class="c1"># KeyFilter only restricts which RELATIONS are even considered as area</span>
    <span class="c1"># candidates in the (cheap) first pass - the second pass still builds</span>
    <span class="c1"># simple-area geometry for every closed way in the file regardless, so</span>
    <span class="c1"># this is an added real cost on top of the main handler.apply_file()</span>
    <span class="c1"># parse, not a free lookup. Timed at ~17s against a real Berlin cleaned</span>
    <span class="c1"># OPL (605MB) - worth it since this is the only way to catch a park</span>
    <span class="c1"># this size and shape mapped as a relation.</span>
    <span class="n">key_filter</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">osmium_filter</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">KeyFilter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'leisure'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'tourism'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'boundary'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'landuse'</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">file_processor</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">osmium</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">FileProcessor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cleaned_opl_path</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">with_areas</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">key_filter</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">polygons</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">area</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">file_processor</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">area</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">is_area</span><span class="p">()</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">area</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">from_way</span><span class="p">():</span>
            <span class="k">continue</span>
        <span class="n">tags</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">dict</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">area</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">_is_green_space</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="k">continue</span>
        <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">outer_ring</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">area</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">outer_rings</span><span class="p">():</span>
                <span class="n">shell</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[(</span><span class="n">node_ref</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">node_ref</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">node_ref</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">outer_ring</span><span class="p">]</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">shell</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="k">continue</span>
                <span class="n">holes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[[(</span><span class="n">node_ref</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">node_ref</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">node_ref</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">inner_ring</span><span class="p">]</span>
                         <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">inner_ring</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">area</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">inner_rings</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">outer_ring</span><span class="p">)]</span>
                <span class="n">poly</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Polygon</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">shell</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">holes</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">poly</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">is_valid</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">poly</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">poly</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">buffer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">poly</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">is_valid</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">poly</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">is_empty</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">poly</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">area</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">polygons</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">poly</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">except</span> <span class="ne">RuntimeError</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="c1"># "Illegal access to removed OSM object" - the area assembly</span>
            <span class="c1"># buffer can in rare cases get invalidated; extraction happens</span>
            <span class="c1"># inline within this same loop iteration specifically to avoid</span>
            <span class="c1"># that, but a malformed relation could still hit it. Skip it,</span>
            <span class="c1"># same as the try/except around simple-way polygon capture.</span>
            <span class="k">continue</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">polygons</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_save_green_space_cache</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">polygons</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">path</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Serializes captured green-space polygons (built during OSM parsing in</span>
<span class="sd">    build_base_demand()) to a small WKT-list JSON file, so enrich_demand()</span>
<span class="sd">    can rebuild an identical GreenSpaceIndex later without re-parsing the</span>
<span class="sd">    full (multi-hundred-MB) cleaned OPL file just to get these back.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">makedirs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dirname</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">exist_ok</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">with</span> <span class="nb">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"w"</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">json</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dump</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="n">poly</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">wkt</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">poly</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">polygons</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="p">)</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_load_green_space_cache</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Inverse of _save_green_space_cache(). Returns [] (not an error) if the</span>
<span class="sd">    cache doesn't exist yet - callers should treat this the same as "no</span>
<span class="sd">    green-space polygons found", same as build_base_demand() does when OSM</span>
<span class="sd">    genuinely has none for this city.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exists</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="k">with</span> <span class="nb">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"r"</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">wkt_list</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">json</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">shapely_wkt</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">loads</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">w</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">w</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">wkt_list</span><span class="p">]</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">prepare_cleaned_pbf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">raw_file</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cleaned_file</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exists</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cleaned_file</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Optimized OPL file '</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">cleaned_file</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">' exists. Skipping preparation."</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="kc">True</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Preparing map data (Extract -&gt; Filter -&gt; Convert)..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    
    <span class="n">bbox_str</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LON</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LAT</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LON</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LAT</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>
    <span class="n">extract_file</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"city_extract.osm.pbf"</span>
    <span class="n">subprocess</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">run</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="s2">"osmium"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"extract"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"-b"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">bbox_str</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">raw_file</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"-o"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">extract_file</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"--overwrite"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">check</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">temp_filtered</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"city_filtered.osm.pbf"</span>
    
    <span class="c1"># Adding landuse extraction to the filter</span>
    <span class="n">tags_filter</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
        <span class="s2">"nwr/building=*"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"nwr/amenity=*"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"nwr/shop=*"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"nwr/office=*"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s2">"nwr/leisure=park,nature_reserve,stadium,sports_centre,water_park"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s2">"nwr/tourism=theme_park,zoo,aquarium"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="s2">"nwr/boundary=national_park"</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="c1"># recreation_ground added alongside commercial/industrial/retail</span>
        <span class="c1"># after finding Tempelhofer Feld is tagged landuse=recreation_ground</span>
        <span class="c1"># (on a relation) rather than leisure=park - without this, the whole</span>
        <span class="c1"># thing was silently dropped before Python ever got a chance to see</span>
        <span class="c1"># it, "nwr/" here matches nodes/ways/relations alike.</span>
        <span class="s2">"nwr/landuse=commercial,industrial,retail,recreation_ground"</span>
    <span class="p">]</span>
    <span class="n">subprocess</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">run</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="s2">"osmium"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"tags-filter"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">extract_file</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">tags_filter</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"-o"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">temp_filtered</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"--overwrite"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">check</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Converting to OPL format for high-speed parsing..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">makedirs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dirname</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cleaned_file</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">exist_ok</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">subprocess</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">run</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="s2">"osmium"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"cat"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">temp_filtered</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"-o"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cleaned_file</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"--overwrite"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">check</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
    
    <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">remove</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">extract_file</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">remove</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">temp_filtered</span><span class="p">)</span>
    
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Map preparation complete."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="kc">True</span>

<span class="k">class</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">OSMHandler</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">osmium</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">SimpleHandler</span><span class="p">):</span>
    <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="fm">__init__</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="nb">super</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="fm">__init__</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">raw_job_nodes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
        <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">raw_home_nodes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
        <span class="c1"># Real polygon geometry for green-space ways (park/nature_reserve/</span>
        <span class="c1"># water_park/theme_park/zoo/aquarium/national_park boundary) - kept</span>
        <span class="c1"># around after use (unlike _green_space_edge_location(), which only</span>
        <span class="c1"># needed nodes[0] + a centroid) so enrich_utils.py's GreenSpaceIndex</span>
        <span class="c1"># can check whether coordinates WE generate later (split siblings,</span>
        <span class="c1"># depot's own SO_ agglomeration centroids) land inside real terrain,</span>
        <span class="c1"># not just whether they're too close to another point. See the</span>
        <span class="c1"># Tempelhofer Feld case: a huge, mostly-empty park where our own</span>
        <span class="c1"># generated points had nothing stopping them from drifting into the</span>
        <span class="c1"># middle of it.</span>
        <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">green_space_polygons</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
        <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">min_lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max_lat</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'inf'</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'-inf'</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">min_lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max_lon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'inf'</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'-inf'</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">process_element</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">elem_id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LAT</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">lat</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LAT</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LON</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">lon</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LON</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="k">return</span>
            
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">lat</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">min_lat</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">min_lat</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">lat</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">lat</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max_lat</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max_lat</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">lat</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">lon</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">min_lon</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">min_lon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">lon</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">lon</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max_lon</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max_lon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">lon</span>
        
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'floating'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'yes'</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'location'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'water'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'underwater'</span><span class="p">]:</span>
            <span class="k">return</span>
            
        <span class="n">b_type</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'building'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="s1">''</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">b_type</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'houseboat'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'boathouse'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'floating_home'</span><span class="p">]:</span>
            <span class="k">return</span>

        <span class="n">is_special</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span>
            <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'amenity'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">SPECIAL_AMENITIES</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">or</span>
            <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'leisure'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">SPECIAL_LEISURE</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">or</span>
            <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'tourism'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">SPECIAL_TOURISM</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">or</span>
            <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'boundary'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'national_park'</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="n">is_job</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">b_type</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">JOB_TAGS</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="nb">any</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">key</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">key</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">JOB_INDICATOR_KEYS</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">is_special</span>
        
        <span class="n">is_home</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">False</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">is_job</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">b_type</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">RESIDENTIAL_TAGS</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">b_type</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'apartments'</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">b_type</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'yes'</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">is_home</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">True</span>

        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">is_job</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">is_home</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">return</span>

        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">is_job</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'shop'</span><span class="p">):</span>
                <span class="n">cap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">randint</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">CAPACITY_SHOP</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># no levels scaling - a</span>
                                                        <span class="c1"># shop node is one unit</span>
                                                        <span class="c1"># regardless of the</span>
                                                        <span class="c1"># building's height</span>
            <span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">tags</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'office'</span><span class="p">):</span>
                <span class="n">cap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">randint</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">CAPACITY_OFFICE</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_levels_multiplier</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">))</span>
            <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">cap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">randint</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">CAPACITY_JOBS</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_levels_multiplier</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">))</span>

            <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">raw_job_nodes</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span>
                <span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">elem_id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"lat"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"lon"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span>
                <span class="s2">"capacity"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="p">,</span>
                <span class="s2">"is_special"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">is_special</span>
            <span class="p">})</span>
        <span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">is_home</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">b_type</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'apartments'</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">cap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">randint</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">CAPACITY_APARTMENTS</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_levels_multiplier</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">))</span>
            <span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">b_type</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'hotel'</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">cap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">randint</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">CAPACITY_HOTEL</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">_levels_multiplier</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">))</span>
            <span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">b_type</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'yes'</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">cap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">randint</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">CAPACITY_YES_WILDCARD</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># too ambiguous a</span>
