                                                                <span class="c1"># tag to trust</span>
                                                                <span class="c1"># levels scaling</span>
            <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">cap</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">random</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">randint</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="n">CAPACITY_HOUSES</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># single-family house -</span>
                                                          <span class="c1"># more floors isn't</span>
                                                          <span class="c1"># more households</span>

            <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">raw_home_nodes</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="s2">"lat"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"lon"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"capacity"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">cap</span><span class="p">})</span>

    <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">node</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">n</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="c1"># A bare point marker directly tagged leisure=park/nature_reserve/</span>
            <span class="c1"># water_park or tourism=theme_park/zoo/aquarium (no building) is</span>
            <span class="c1"># almost always a sub-feature *inside* a larger park/reserve</span>
            <span class="c1"># polygon (a bench, meadow, viewpoint marker, ticket booth) - that</span>
            <span class="c1"># polygon (handled in way() below) already generates its own job</span>
            <span class="c1"># hub for the whole area. Counting the marker too would double up</span>
            <span class="c1"># demand at essentially the same spot, and as a bare point it has</span>
            <span class="c1"># no polygon to push outward from either, so it would sit</span>
            <span class="c1"># wherever the marker happens to be - often deep inside the green</span>
            <span class="c1"># area. Skip it; the parent polygon already covers this facility.</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">_is_green_space</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="s1">'building'</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">n</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">return</span>
            <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">process_element</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">n</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">n</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">location</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">n</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">location</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">way</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">w</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">w</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">_is_green_space</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">w</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">):</span>
                    <span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">_green_space_edge_location</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">w</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">_capture_green_space_polygon</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">w</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">w</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">nodes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">location</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">w</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">nodes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">location</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lon</span>
                <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">process_element</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">w</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">w</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">tags</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">except</span> <span class="n">osmium</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">InvalidLocationError</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">pass</span>

    <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_capture_green_space_polygon</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">w</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="c1"># Real building/park data occasionally has degenerate rings (too</span>
        <span class="c1"># few points, self-intersections, duplicate closing vertex issues)</span>
        <span class="c1"># - shapely raises/produces an invalid geometry for those. This is</span>
        <span class="c1"># a nice-to-have exclusion zone, not a correctness-critical path,</span>
        <span class="c1"># so skip anything shapely can't build cleanly rather than let one</span>
        <span class="c1"># bad way abort the whole parse.</span>
        <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">ring</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">location</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">n</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">location</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">n</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">w</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">nodes</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ring</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">return</span>
            <span class="n">poly</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Polygon</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ring</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">poly</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">is_valid</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">poly</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">poly</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">buffer</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span>  <span class="c1"># standard shapely fix for minor self-intersections</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">poly</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">is_valid</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">poly</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">is_empty</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">poly</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">area</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">green_space_polygons</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">poly</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">except</span> <span class="ne">Exception</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">pass</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">cluster_organic</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">nodes</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">radius_km</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Merges nearby raw building nodes into consolidated "hub" nodes: walking</span>
<span class="sd">    the list in order, each not-yet-absorbed node becomes a new cluster at</span>
<span class="sd">    its OWN coordinate (not a centroid), and any other not-yet-absorbed</span>
<span class="sd">    node within radius_km of it gets folded in (capacity summed, is_special</span>
<span class="sd">    OR'd) and marked absorbed so it's never its own cluster later.</span>

<span class="sd">    This is a performance rewrite of the exact same algorithm - same</span>
<span class="sd">    Euclidean-in-degrees distance metric the original hand-rolled bucket</span>
<span class="sd">    grid used (not true geographic/haversine distance - that approximation</span>
<span class="sd">    is unchanged, only how neighbors are found is different), same</span>
<span class="sd">    processing order, same output. Neighbor lookups now go through</span>
<span class="sd">    scipy's cKDTree instead of a manual Python dict-bucket + nested loop.</span>

<span class="sd">    Queries are done LAZILY, one point at a time, only for points still</span>
<span class="sd">    unprocessed when the loop reaches them - NOT as one upfront batched</span>
<span class="sd">    query_ball_point(coords, ...) call for every point. That seems like</span>
<span class="sd">    the obvious "vectorize it" move, but real building data clusters into</span>
<span class="sd">    dense blocks, and in a tight cluster of k mutually-close points only</span>
<span class="sd">    the FIRST one (in list order) ever actually needs its neighbor list -</span>
<span class="sd">    every other point in that cluster gets absorbed and skipped before its</span>
<span class="sd">    own turn. Precomputing all n lists upfront still pays the full O(k)</span>
<span class="sd">    cost for every one of those k points regardless, which measured out</span>
<span class="sd">    as SLOWER than the original bucket grid on realistically-clustered</span>
<span class="sd">    data (not uniform-random, which is what made the first version of</span>
<span class="sd">    this rewrite look like a win in less representative testing).</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="n">n</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">nodes</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">n</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

    <span class="n">radius_deg</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">radius_km</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mf">111.0</span>
    <span class="n">coords</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">array</span><span class="p">([[</span><span class="n">node</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"lat"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">node</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"lon"</span><span class="p">]]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">node</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">nodes</span><span class="p">])</span>
    <span class="n">tree</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">cKDTree</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">coords</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">processed</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">np</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">zeros</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">dtype</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="nb">bool</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">final_clusters</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">processed</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">]:</span>
            <span class="k">continue</span>
        <span class="n">node</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">nodes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="n">lat_i</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lon_i</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">node</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"lat"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">node</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"lon"</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="n">capacity</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">node</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"capacity"</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="n">is_special</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">node</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"is_special"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">processed</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">True</span>

        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">j</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">tree</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">query_ball_point</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">lat_i</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lon_i</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">r</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">radius_deg</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">j</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">processed</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">j</span><span class="p">]:</span>
                <span class="k">continue</span>
            <span class="n">neighbor</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">nodes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">j</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="c1"># query_ball_point includes points at exactly r (&lt;=); the</span>
            <span class="c1"># original bucket-grid code used a strict &lt; radius_deg</span>
            <span class="c1"># comparison - re-check exactly so behavior matches bit-for-bit</span>
            <span class="c1"># (this candidate set is already small, so the extra check is</span>
            <span class="c1"># cheap).</span>
            <span class="n">dlat</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">lat_i</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">neighbor</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"lat"</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="n">dlon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">lon_i</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">neighbor</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"lon"</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dlat</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">dlat</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">dlon</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">dlon</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">**</span> <span class="mf">0.5</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="n">radius_deg</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">continue</span>
            <span class="n">capacity</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="n">neighbor</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"capacity"</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">neighbor</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"is_special"</span><span class="p">):</span>
                <span class="n">is_special</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">True</span>
            <span class="n">processed</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">j</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">True</span>

        <span class="n">final_clusters</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span>
            <span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"cluster_</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">final_clusters</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="s2">"lat"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">lat_i</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"lon"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">lon_i</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="s2">"capacity"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">capacity</span><span class="p">,</span>
            <span class="s2">"is_special"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">is_special</span>
        <span class="p">})</span>

    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">final_clusters</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">initialize_map_data</span><span class="p">():</span>
    <span class="n">target_dir</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">"raw_map_files/data_osrm"</span>
    <span class="n">target_full_path</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">abspath</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_dir</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="c1"># Set project_root to data_osrm directory</span>
    <span class="n">project_root</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">target_full_path</span>
    <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">makedirs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_full_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">exist_ok</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>

    
    <span class="c1"># Check if OSMPBF_FILE file symlink already exists inside target_full_path</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exists</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_full_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">OSMPBF_FILE</span><span class="p">)):</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">OSMPBF_FILE</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> is not present in </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">target_dir</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">, copying..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">shutil</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">copy</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">getcwd</span><span class="p">(),</span> <span class="n">OSMPBF_FILE</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_full_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">OSMPBF_FILE</span><span class="p">))</span>
    
    <span class="c1"># Paths relative to the container mount point /data</span>
    <span class="n">pbf_input</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"/data/</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">OSMPBF_FILE</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>
    <span class="n">osrm_output_base</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"/data/germany-latest"</span>
    
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exists</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">target_full_path</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">/germany-latest.osrm.cell_metrics"</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OSRM map data files already exist. Skipping generation."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Generating OSRM map data in </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">target_dir</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
            
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exists</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_full_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"germany-latest.osrm"</span><span class="p">)):</span>
                <span class="c1"># 1. Extract: Use -w /data/raw_map_files/data_osrm</span>
                <span class="n">subprocess</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">run</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="s2">"docker"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"run"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"--rm"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"-t"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"-v"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">project_root</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">:/data"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="s2">"-w"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">target_full_path</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"osrm/osrm-backend"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="s2">"osrm-extract"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">pbf_input</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"-p"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"/opt/car.lua"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="s2">"--threads"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">OSRM_THREADS</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">check</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>

            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exists</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_full_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"germany-latest.osrm.partition"</span><span class="p">)):</span>
                <span class="c1"># 2. Partition: Target the output in the subfolder</span>
                <span class="n">subprocess</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">run</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="s2">"docker"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"run"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"--rm"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"-t"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"-v"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">project_root</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">:/data"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="s2">"-w"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">target_full_path</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"osrm/osrm-backend"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"osrm-partition"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">osrm_output_base</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">.osrm"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"--threads"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">OSRM_THREADS</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">check</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>

            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exists</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_full_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"germany-latest.osrm.cell_metrics"</span><span class="p">)):</span>
                <span class="c1"># 3. Customize: Target the output in the subfolder</span>
                <span class="n">subprocess</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">run</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="s2">"docker"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"run"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"--rm"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"-t"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"-v"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">project_root</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">:/data"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="s2">"-w"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">target_full_path</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"osrm/osrm-backend"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"osrm-customize"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">osrm_output_base</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">.osrm"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"--threads"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">OSRM_THREADS</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">check</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">finally</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Map data generation complete."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">target_full_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">osrm_output_base</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">start_osrm_container</span><span class="p">():</span>
    <span class="n">target_full_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">osrm_output_base</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">initialize_map_data</span><span class="p">()</span>

    <span class="c1"># Clean up any leftover container from a previous crashed/aborted run</span>
    <span class="c1"># (otherwise "docker run --name osrm-backend" below fails with "name already in use")</span>
    <span class="n">subprocess</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">run</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="s2">"docker"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"rm"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"-f"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"osrm-backend"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">check</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="n">stdout</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">subprocess</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">DEVNULL</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">stderr</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">subprocess</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">DEVNULL</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Starting OSRM backend container..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">subprocess</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">run</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="s2">"docker"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"run"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"-d"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"--name"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"osrm-backend"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"--network"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"host"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s2">"-v"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">target_full_path</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">:/data"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"-w"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">target_full_path</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"osrm/osrm-backend"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s2">"osrm-routed"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"--algorithm"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"mld"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">osrm_output_base</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">.osrm"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s2">"--threads"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">OSRM_THREADS</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">check</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># Poll until ready. Use a real coordinate pair from this city's own BBOX</span>
    <span class="c1"># (rounded like the old hardcoded check) instead of a fixed Frankfurt-area point.</span>
    <span class="n">check_lon1</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">check_lat1</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LON</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LAT</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">check_lon2</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">check_lat2</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LON</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LAT</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">health_url</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">OSRM_URL</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">/route/v1/driving/</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">check_lon1</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">check_lat1</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">;</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">check_lon2</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">check_lat2</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Waiting for OSRM to load map into memory..."</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">""</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">flush</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">60</span><span class="p">):</span> <span class="c1"># Try for 60 seconds</span>
        <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">requests</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">health_url</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">timeout</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">status_code</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">200</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">" Ready!"</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">return</span>
        <span class="k">except</span> <span class="n">requests</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">RequestException</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"."</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">""</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">flush</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">time</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sleep</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">raise</span> <span class="ne">RuntimeError</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OSRM container failed to start in time."</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">stop_osrm_container</span><span class="p">():</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">Stopping and removing OSRM container..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="c1"># check=False: if the container never started (e.g. start_osrm_container</span>
    <span class="c1"># raised before/while starting it), there's nothing to stop/remove - don't</span>
    <span class="c1"># let cleanup itself throw and mask the original error.</span>
    <span class="n">subprocess</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">run</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="s2">"docker"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"stop"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"osrm-backend"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">check</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">subprocess</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">run</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="s2">"docker"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"rm"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"osrm-backend"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">check</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">)</span>


<span class="k">class</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nc">_CpuSampler</span><span class="p">:</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Background sampler that polls `docker stats` for a container's CPU%</span>
<span class="sd">    (100% = one full core saturated - docker reports this uncapped, so 4</span>
<span class="sd">    cores fully busy shows as 400%) roughly once a second while a `with`</span>
<span class="sd">    block runs, so we can tell empirically whether OSRM is actually</span>
<span class="sd">    CPU-bound during routing instead of guessing from request-throughput</span>
<span class="sd">    math. Runs in a daemon thread so it can't block process exit if</span>
<span class="sd">    something goes wrong; failures to sample (docker not found, container</span>
<span class="sd">    already gone, transient parse error) are swallowed rather than crashing</span>
<span class="sd">    the whole run - this is a diagnostic, not a critical path.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="fm">__init__</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">container_name</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">interval</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">container_name</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">container_name</span>
        <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">interval</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">interval</span>
        <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">samples</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
        <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">_stop_event</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">threading</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Event</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">_thread</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">None</span>

    <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_run</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">while</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">_stop_event</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">is_set</span><span class="p">():</span>
            <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">result</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">subprocess</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">run</span><span class="p">(</span>
                    <span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"docker"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"stats"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"--no-stream"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"--format"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"{{.CPUPerc}}"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                     <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">container_name</span><span class="p">],</span>
                    <span class="n">capture_output</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">text</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">timeout</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">5</span>
                <span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">returncode</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">stdout</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">strip</span><span class="p">():</span>
                    <span class="n">pct</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">stdout</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">strip</span><span class="p">()</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">rstrip</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"%"</span><span class="p">))</span>
                    <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">samples</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pct</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">except</span> <span class="ne">Exception</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">pass</span>
            <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">_stop_event</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">wait</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">interval</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="fm">__enter__</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">_thread</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">threading</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Thread</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">_run</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">daemon</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">_thread</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">start</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="bp">self</span>

    <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="fm">__exit__</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">exc_type</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">exc_val</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">exc_tb</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">_stop_event</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">set</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">_thread</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">_thread</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">timeout</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">report</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">threads_configured</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">samples</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"  (No CPU samples collected - `docker stats` may not be "</span>
                  <span class="s2">"available in this environment.)"</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">return</span>
        <span class="n">avg_cpu</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">samples</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">samples</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">max_cpu</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">samples</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">ceiling</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">threads_configured</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mi">100</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  OSRM container CPU: avg </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">avg_cpu</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">.0f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">%, peak </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">max_cpu</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">.0f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">% "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"of a possible </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">ceiling</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">% (100% = 1 full core, "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">threads_configured</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> OSRM threads configured) "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"[</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="bp">self</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">samples</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> sample(s)]"</span><span class="p">)</span>

<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">build_base_demand</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Base stage of the modular pipeline: OSM parsing, green-space capture,</span>
<span class="sd">    optional Zensus calibration, airport mega-hub snapping, INSPIRE grid</span>
<span class="sd">    mapping, QZM commuter assignment, and base OSRM routing - everything</span>
<span class="sd">    that's slow to regenerate and doesn't depend on RES_SIZE_RATIO/</span>
<span class="sd">    JOB_SIZE_RATIO tuning or hand-edited special-demand data. Saves a checkpoint to BASE_OUTPUT_FILE</span>
<span class="sd">    (raw points/pops, no clustering/consolidation/special demand yet) plus a</span>
<span class="sd">    green-space polygon cache, both consumed by enrich_demand(). Returns</span>
<span class="sd">    True on success, False on any early-exit condition (no buildings found,</span>
<span class="sd">    missing commuter CSV, airport hub coordinates still pending manual</span>
<span class="sd">    input) - see all(), which uses this to decide whether to proceed to</span>
<span class="sd">    enrich_demand().</span>

<span class="sd">    autofill_special_demand: overrides the --autofill-special-demand CLI</span>
<span class="sd">    flag when called programmatically (e.g. from a DemandGen instance) -</span>
<span class="sd">    defaults to whatever the CLI flag resolved to (True unless</span>
<span class="sd">    --no-autofill-special-demand was passed) when left as None.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">_cli_args</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span>

    <span class="n">cleaned_opl_path</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">CITY_RAW_DIR</span><span class="si">}{</span><span class="n">OPL_CLEANED_FILE</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">prepare_cleaned_pbf</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">OSMPBF_FILE</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cleaned_opl_path</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="kc">False</span>

    <span class="c1"># Detect/confirm named special demand landmarks (universities, hospitals,</span>
    <span class="c1"># stadiums, etc.) from the same cleaned OSM data, before doing anything</span>
    <span class="c1"># heavier. This is a good spot for it since it may pause on `input()`</span>
    <span class="c1"># waiting on you to fill in capacity numbers - no OSRM container is</span>
    <span class="c1"># running yet, so nothing sits idle while you do that. Only entries with</span>
    <span class="c1"># a real capacity/enrollment/attendance number get used later, in the</span>
    <span class="c1"># enrichment step at the end of this function (see special_demand_utils.py).</span>
    <span class="n">bbox</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LON</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LAT</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LON</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LAT</span><span class="p">]</span>
    <span class="n">ready_special_demand</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">detect_and_confirm_special_demand</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">CITY_CODE</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">RAW_BASE_DIR</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cleaned_opl_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">bbox</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">autofill_landmarks</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># Phase timings, so a slow run tells you exactly where the time went</span>
    <span class="c1"># instead of guessing - printed as a summary at the very end. Starts here</span>
    <span class="c1"># (not at the top of the function), so it never counts time spent</span>
    <span class="c1"># actually reviewing/typing special demand numbers by hand.</span>
    <span class="n">_phase_times</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{}</span>
    <span class="n">_t_phase_start</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">time</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">label</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">nonlocal</span> <span class="n">_t_phase_start</span>
        <span class="n">now</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">time</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="n">_phase_times</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">label</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">now</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">_t_phase_start</span>
        <span class="n">_t_phase_start</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">now</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">Loading '</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">cleaned_opl_path</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">'..."</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">" "</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">flush</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">handler</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">OSMHandler</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">apply_file</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cleaned_opl_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">locations</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OK"</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">raw_home_nodes</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">raw_job_nodes</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">[ERROR] No buildings found within the specified bounding box."</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="kc">False</span>

    <span class="c1"># Second pass, specifically for green-space polygons mapped as</span>
    <span class="c1"># MULTIPOLYGON RELATIONS (e.g. Tempelhofer Feld) rather than a single</span>
    <span class="c1"># tagged closed way - see capture_green_space_relations()'s docstring</span>
    <span class="c1"># for why OSMHandler.way() can never see these on its own.</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Scanning for green-space multipolygon relations..."</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">" "</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">flush</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">green_space_polygons</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">extend</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">capture_green_space_relations</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cleaned_opl_path</span><span class="p">))</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OK"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Scanning green-space multipolygon relations"</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># Built once here, from whatever green-space polygons OSM parsing just</span>
    <span class="c1"># captured, and reused for every downstream check (split placement,</span>
    <span class="c1"># depot's own agglomerate_pops() SO_ centroids) - see GreenSpaceIndex's</span>
    <span class="c1"># docstring in enrich_utils.py for why a single OSM-extraction-time edge</span>
    <span class="c1"># push isn't enough on its own.</span>
    <span class="n">green_index</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">GreenSpaceIndex</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">green_space_polygons</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">green_space_polygons</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  -&gt; Captured </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">green_space_polygons</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> green-space "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"polygon(s) for later placement checks."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">_save_green_space_cache</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">green_space_polygons</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">GREEN_SPACE_CACHE_FILE</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="c1"># Optional: calibrate residential building capacity against a real</span>
    <span class="c1"># measured Zensus 2022 100m population count, instead of relying solely</span>
    <span class="c1"># on the OSM-heuristic CAPACITY_* ranges - see zensus_utils.py's module</span>
    <span class="c1"># comment for what this does and why, and _find_zensus_grid_csv()'s</span>
    <span class="c1"># docstring for where the file needs to live. No-op (prints a note and</span>
    <span class="c1"># continues exactly as before) if the file hasn't been downloaded yet.</span>
    <span class="n">zensus_csv_path</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">_find_zensus_grid_csv</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">zensus_csv_path</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Loading Zensus 2022 population grid from '</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">zensus_csv_path</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">'..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">zensus_bbox</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">min_lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">min_lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max_lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max_lat</span><span class="p">]</span>
        <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">zensus_grid</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ZensusPopulationGrid</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">zensus_csv_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">bbox</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">zensus_bbox</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">calibrate_residential_capacity</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">raw_home_nodes</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">zensus_grid</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">except</span> <span class="ne">Exception</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">e</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  [WARNING] Couldn't use the Zensus population grid (</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">e</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">) - "</span>
                  <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"falling back to OSM-heuristic residential capacity only."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"No Zensus 2022 population grid found (optional) - residential "</span>
              <span class="s2">"capacity will use OSM-heuristic estimates only. See "</span>
              <span class="s2">"zensus_utils.py's module comment for how to add one."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Zensus population grid calibration (optional)"</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">avg_lat_rad</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">radians</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">min_lat</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max_lat</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mf">2.0</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">height_km</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max_lat</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">min_lat</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mf">111.0</span>
    <span class="n">width_km</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">max_lon</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">min_lon</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mf">111.0</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">cos</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">avg_lat_rad</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">map_area_sqkm</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mf">1.0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">width_km</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">height_km</span><span class="p">)</span>
    
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">Map Bounds Detected: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">width_km</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">.1f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">km x </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">height_km</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">.1f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">km"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Total Area: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">map_area_sqkm</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">.1f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> sq/km"</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Clustering </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">raw_home_nodes</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> residential and </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">raw_job_nodes</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> job buildings in parallel..."</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">" "</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">flush</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
    
    <span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">ThreadPoolExecutor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">max_workers</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">executor</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">future_homes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">executor</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">submit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cluster_organic</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">raw_home_nodes</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">RES_MERGE_RADIUS</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">future_jobs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">executor</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">submit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">cluster_organic</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">handler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">raw_job_nodes</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">JOB_MERGE_RADIUS</span><span class="p">)</span>
        
        <span class="n">final_home_nodes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">future_homes</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="n">final_job_nodes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">future_jobs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="p">()</span>
        
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OK"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Result: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">final_home_nodes</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> organic residential hubs."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Result: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">final_job_nodes</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> organic job hubs."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OSM parsing + organic clustering"</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">Generating demand points..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Initializing EPSG:3035 Transformer..."</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">" "</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">flush</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">transformer</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">Transformer</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">from_crs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"EPSG:4326"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"EPSG:3035"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">always_xy</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OK"</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exists</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">AIRPORT_GEOJSON</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Parsing Airport data from </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">AIRPORT_GEOJSON</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">..."</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">" "</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">flush</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">with</span> <span class="nb">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">AIRPORT_GEOJSON</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'r'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">geojson_data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">json</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">)</span>
            
        <span class="n">features_data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">feature</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">geojson_data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'features'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[]):</span>
            <span class="n">geom</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">feature</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'geometry'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{})</span>
            <span class="n">pts</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">geom</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'type'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'Polygon'</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">ring</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">geom</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'coordinates'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[]):</span> <span class="n">pts</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">extend</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ring</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">geom</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'type'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s1">'MultiPolygon'</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">poly</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">geom</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'coordinates'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[]):</span>
                    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">ring</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">poly</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">pts</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">extend</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ring</span><span class="p">)</span>
                        
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">pts</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">lats</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lons</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">pts</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">pts</span><span class="p">]</span>
                <span class="n">features_data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span>
                    <span class="s2">"pts"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">pts</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"count"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pts</span><span class="p">),</span>
                    <span class="s2">"center_lat"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lats</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lats</span><span class="p">),</span>
                    <span class="s2">"center_lon"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lons</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lons</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="p">})</span>
        
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">features_data</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">airport_clusters</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
            <span class="n">CLUSTER_RADIUS_DEG</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mf">0.04</span> 
            
            <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">feat</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">sorted</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">features_data</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">key</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="k">lambda</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'count'</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">reverse</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">):</span>
                <span class="n">placed</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">False</span>
                <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">ap</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">airport_clusters</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">dist</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">hypot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">feat</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"center_lat"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"center_lat"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">feat</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"center_lon"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"center_lon"</span><span class="p">])</span>
                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">dist</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="n">CLUSTER_RADIUS_DEG</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"features"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">feat</span><span class="p">)</span>
                        <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"center_lat"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"center_lat"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">f</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"features"</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"features"</span><span class="p">])</span>
                        <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"center_lon"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"center_lon"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">f</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"features"</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"features"</span><span class="p">])</span>
                        <span class="n">placed</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">True</span>
                        <span class="k">break</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">placed</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">airport_clusters</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span>
                        <span class="s2">"features"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">feat</span><span class="p">],</span>
                        <span class="s2">"center_lat"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">feat</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"center_lat"</span><span class="p">],</span>
                        <span class="s2">"center_lon"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">feat</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"center_lon"</span><span class="p">]</span>
                    <span class="p">})</span>
            
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OK"</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Preparing Interactive Hub Configurations..."</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">" "</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">flush</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
            
            <span class="n">airport_hubs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
            <span class="n">detected_airports</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{}</span>
            
            <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ap</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">enumerate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">airport_clusters</span><span class="p">):</span>
                <span class="n">ap_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"mega_hub_airport_</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>
