                <span class="n">valid_lats</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">valid_lons</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[],</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
                <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">feat</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"features"</span><span class="p">]:</span>
                    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">feat</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"pts"</span><span class="p">]:</span>
                        <span class="n">valid_lons</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">)</span>
                        <span class="n">valid_lats</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">)</span>
                
                <span class="n">default_lat</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">valid_lats</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">valid_lats</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="n">default_lon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">valid_lons</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">valid_lons</span><span class="p">)</span>
                
                <span class="n">all_x</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">all_y</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[],</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
                <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">zip</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">valid_lons</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">valid_lats</span><span class="p">):</span>
                    <span class="n">x</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">y</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">transformer</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">transform</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="n">all_x</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">x</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="n">all_y</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">y</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    
                <span class="n">airport_hubs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span>
                    <span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">ap_id</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s2">"bbox"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">all_x</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">all_x</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">all_y</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">all_y</span><span class="p">)),</span>
                    <span class="s2">"capacity"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s2">"grids"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">set</span><span class="p">()</span>
                <span class="p">})</span>
                
                <span class="n">detected_airports</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">ap_id</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span>
                    <span class="s2">"name"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Airport Cluster </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s2">"default_center_lat"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">default_lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">6</span><span class="p">),</span>
                    <span class="s2">"default_center_lon"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">default_lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">6</span><span class="p">),</span>
                    <span class="s2">"override_lat"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">,</span>
                    <span class="s2">"override_lon"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
                <span class="p">}</span>

            <span class="n">needs_user_input</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">False</span>
            <span class="n">custom_hubs_data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"airports"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">{}}</span>
            
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exists</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">CUSTOM_HUBS_JSON</span><span class="p">):</span>
                <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="k">with</span> <span class="nb">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">CUSTOM_HUBS_JSON</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'r'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="n">custom_hubs_data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">json</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">except</span> <span class="n">json</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">JSONDecodeError</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">[ERROR] </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">CUSTOM_HUBS_JSON</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> is invalid JSON. Please fix it or delete it."</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="n">sys</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    
            <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">ap_id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">def_data</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">detected_airports</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">items</span><span class="p">():</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">ap_id</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">custom_hubs_data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"airports"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{}):</span>
                    <span class="n">custom_hubs_data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">setdefault</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"airports"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{})[</span><span class="n">ap_id</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">def_data</span>
                    <span class="n">needs_user_input</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">True</span>
                <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">user_data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">custom_hubs_data</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"airports"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="n">ap_id</span><span class="p">]</span>
                    <span class="n">olat</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">user_data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"override_lat"</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="n">olon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">user_data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"override_lon"</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    
                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">olat</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">olon</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="n">needs_user_input</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">True</span>
                    <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="n">olat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">olon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">olat</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">olon</span><span class="p">)</span>
                        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LAT</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">olat</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LAT</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LON</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">olon</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LON</span><span class="p">):</span>
                            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">[ERROR] Override coordinates for </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">ap_id</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> are outside the map bounding box!"</span><span class="p">)</span>
                            <span class="n">sys</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>
                            
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">needs_user_input</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">makedirs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dirname</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">CUSTOM_HUBS_JSON</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">exist_ok</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">with</span> <span class="nb">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">CUSTOM_HUBS_JSON</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'w'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">json</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dump</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">custom_hubs_data</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">indent</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">4</span><span class="p">)</span>

                <span class="n">pending_airport_ids</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span>
                    <span class="n">ap_id</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">ap_id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">def_data</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">custom_hubs_data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"airports"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{})</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">items</span><span class="p">()</span>
                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">def_data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"override_lat"</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">def_data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"override_lon"</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span>
                <span class="p">]</span>
                <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">[ACTION NEEDED] </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pending_airport_ids</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> airport hub(s) need a manual "</span>
                      <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"terminal coordinate override in '</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">CUSTOM_HUBS_JSON</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">'."</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Opening each one's approximate location in your browser so you can find the exact terminal building..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">ap_id</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">pending_airport_ids</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">def_data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">custom_hubs_data</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"airports"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="n">ap_id</span><span class="p">]</span>
                    <span class="n">lat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">def_data</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"default_center_lat"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">def_data</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"default_center_lon"</span><span class="p">]</span>
                    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">" -&gt; Opening </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">ap_id</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">: (</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">lat</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">, </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">lon</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">)"</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="n">_open_url_detached</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&amp;query=</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">lat</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">lon</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">)</span>

                <span class="nb">input</span><span class="p">(</span>
                    <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">Open '</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">CUSTOM_HUBS_JSON</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">' and replace 'null' with the exact lat/lon "</span>
                    <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"for the hub(s) above.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">Press Enter once you're done - or just leave it "</span>
                    <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"for later, nothing is lost.</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">"</span>
                <span class="p">)</span>

                <span class="k">with</span> <span class="nb">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">CUSTOM_HUBS_JSON</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s1">'r'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">custom_hubs_data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">json</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">load</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">)</span>

                <span class="n">still_missing</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
                <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">ap_id</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">pending_airport_ids</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">user_data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">custom_hubs_data</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"airports"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="n">ap_id</span><span class="p">]</span>
                    <span class="n">olat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">olon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">user_data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"override_lat"</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">user_data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"override_lon"</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">olat</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">olon</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="n">still_missing</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ap_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="n">olat</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">olon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">olat</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">olon</span><span class="p">)</span>
                        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LAT</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">olat</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LAT</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LON</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">olon</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LON</span><span class="p">):</span>
                            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">[ERROR] Override coordinates for </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">ap_id</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> are outside the map bounding box!"</span><span class="p">)</span>
                            <span class="n">sys</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span>

                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">still_missing</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">Still missing coordinates for: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="s1">', '</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">still_missing</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"No worries - continuing without airport hub snapping for now. "</span>
                          <span class="s2">"Fill them in and re-run whenever you're ready to include them."</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="kc">False</span>

            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OK (Custom coordinates loaded)"</span><span class="p">)</span>
            
            <span class="n">surviving_job_nodes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
            <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">node</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">final_job_nodes</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">nx</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ny</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">transformer</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">transform</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">node</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"lon"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">node</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"lat"</span><span class="p">])</span>
                <span class="n">snapped</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">False</span>
                
                <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">ap</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">airport_hubs</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">min_x</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">max_x</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">min_y</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">max_y</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"bbox"</span><span class="p">]</span>
                    <span class="n">dx</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">min_x</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">nx</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">nx</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">max_x</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="n">dy</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">min_y</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">ny</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ny</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">max_y</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="n">dist_to_bbox</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">hypot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dx</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">dy</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    
                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">dist_to_bbox</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="n">AIRPORT_EDGE_SNAP_RADIUS_METERS</span><span class="p">:</span> 
                        <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"capacity"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="n">node</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"capacity"</span><span class="p">]</span>
                        <span class="n">grid_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"1kmN</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ny</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1000</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">E</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">nx</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1000</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>
                        <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"grids"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">grid_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
                        <span class="n">snapped</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">True</span>
                        <span class="k">break</span> 
                        
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">snapped</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">surviving_job_nodes</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">node</span><span class="p">)</span>
            
            <span class="n">active_airports_count</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
            <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">ap</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">airport_hubs</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"capacity"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">olat</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">custom_hubs_data</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"airports"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]][</span><span class="s2">"override_lat"</span><span class="p">])</span>
                    <span class="n">olon</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">float</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">custom_hubs_data</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"airports"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">]][</span><span class="s2">"override_lon"</span><span class="p">])</span>
                    
                    <span class="n">surviving_job_nodes</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span>
                        <span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">],</span>
                        <span class="s2">"lat"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">olat</span><span class="p">,</span>      
                        <span class="s2">"lon"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">olon</span><span class="p">,</span>      
                        <span class="s2">"capacity"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"capacity"</span><span class="p">],</span>
                        <span class="s2">"is_airport"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span>
                        <span class="s2">"grids"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">ap</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"grids"</span><span class="p">]</span>
                    <span class="p">})</span>
                    <span class="n">active_airports_count</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>
                    
            <span class="n">final_job_nodes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">surviving_job_nodes</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  -&gt; Generated </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">active_airports_count</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> mapped Airport Mega-Hubs."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Airport GeoJSON '</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">AIRPORT_GEOJSON</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">' not found. Skipping airport snapping."</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">points</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">pops</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[],</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">item</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">enumerate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">final_job_nodes</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"is_airport"</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="n">points</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span>
                <span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">],</span> 
                <span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">item</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"lon"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"lat"</span><span class="p">]],</span> 
                <span class="s2">"jobs"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"capacity"</span><span class="p">],</span> 
                <span class="s2">"residents"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> 
                <span class="s2">"popIds"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[],</span>
                <span class="s2">"is_airport"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">,</span>
                <span class="s2">"grids"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"grids"</span><span class="p">],</span>
                <span class="s2">"is_special"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"is_special"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">),</span>
                <span class="s2">"connections"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
            <span class="p">})</span>
        <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">points</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span>
                <span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"dp_job_</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">,</span> 
                <span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">item</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"lon"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"lat"</span><span class="p">]],</span> 
                <span class="s2">"jobs"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"capacity"</span><span class="p">],</span> 
                <span class="s2">"residents"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> 
                <span class="s2">"popIds"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[],</span>
                <span class="s2">"is_special"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"is_special"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">),</span>
                <span class="s2">"connections"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
            <span class="p">})</span>
    
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">item</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">final_home_nodes</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">points</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span>
            <span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">],</span> 
            <span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">item</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"lon"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"lat"</span><span class="p">]],</span> 
            <span class="s2">"jobs"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> 
            <span class="s2">"residents"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">item</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"capacity"</span><span class="p">],</span> 
            <span class="s2">"popIds"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
        <span class="p">})</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Mapping OSM buildings and zones to the INSPIRE 1x1km Grid..."</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">" "</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">flush</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">grid_homes</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">grid_jobs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{},</span> <span class="p">{}</span>

    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">h</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">p</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">points</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residents"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]:</span>
        <span class="n">x</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">y</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">transformer</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">transform</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">])</span>
        <span class="n">gid</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"1kmN</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">y</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1000</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">E</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">x</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1000</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>
        <span class="n">grid_homes</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">setdefault</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gid</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[])</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">h</span><span class="p">)</span>
        
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">j</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">p</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">points</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobs"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]:</span>
        <span class="n">is_special</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"is_special"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"is_airport"</span><span class="p">):</span> <span class="n">is_special</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="kc">True</span> 
        
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"is_airport"</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">gid</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"grids"</span><span class="p">]:</span> 
                <span class="n">grid_jobs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">setdefault</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gid</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"normal"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[],</span> <span class="s2">"special"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[]})[</span><span class="s2">"special"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">j</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">x</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">y</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">transformer</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">transform</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">])</span>
            <span class="n">gid</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"1kmN</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">y</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1000</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">E</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">x</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">//</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">1000</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>
            <span class="n">grid_jobs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">setdefault</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">gid</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="s2">"normal"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[],</span> <span class="s2">"special"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="p">[]})</span>
            
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">is_special</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">grid_jobs</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">gid</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s2">"special"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">j</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">grid_jobs</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">gid</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s2">"normal"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">j</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OK"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    
    <span class="n">pending_routes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
    
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">Parsing real-world commuter matrix from </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">COMMUTERS_CSV_FILE</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">..."</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">" "</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">flush</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="k">with</span> <span class="nb">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">COMMUTERS_CSV_FILE</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">mode</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'r'</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">encoding</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s1">'utf-8'</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">reader</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">csv</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">reader</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">f</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">headers</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">next</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">reader</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">wo_idx</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ao_idx</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">pendler_idx</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">headers</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">index</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"wo_1km"</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">headers</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">index</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"ao_1km"</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">headers</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">index</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"gesamtpendler"</span><span class="p">)</span>

            <span class="c1"># NOTE: this used to spawn a synthetic (not OSM-derived) job point</span>
            <span class="c1"># here when a grid cell had no real job building to route to, or</span>
            <span class="c1"># when every real job building in it was already at</span>
            <span class="c1"># MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_JOB - jittered either into a nearby</span>
            <span class="c1"># commercial/industrial/retail landuse zone, or near an existing</span>
            <span class="c1"># job point in the same grid if no zone existed. Removed: jobs</span>
            <span class="c1"># must now land ONLY on real OSM job buildings (or named special</span>
            <span class="c1"># demand landmarks) - never on an invented point, even one</span>
            <span class="c1"># loosely anchored to a real landuse zone. When a grid cell's</span>
            <span class="c1"># real job capacity is exhausted, assign_commuters() below now</span>
            <span class="c1"># just stops assigning for that (wo, ao) pair instead of</span>
            <span class="c1"># fabricating a place to put the rest - that portion of the CSV's</span>
            <span class="c1"># commuter count for this pair goes unassigned/dropped rather</span>
            <span class="c1"># than being placed somewhere not backed by real building data.</span>
            <span class="c1"># dropped_commuters below tracks exactly how much this costs on</span>
            <span class="c1"># real data - see its summary print after the CSV finishes.</span>
            <span class="n">dropped_commuters</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>  <span class="c1"># [no real job building at all, real jobs all at MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_JOB]</span>

            <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">assign_commuters</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">target_jobs</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">target_count</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">current_homes</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">grid_id</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">is_special</span><span class="p">):</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">current_homes</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">return</span>

                <span class="n">commuters_to_assign</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">target_count</span>
                <span class="n">iterations</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>

                <span class="k">while</span> <span class="n">commuters_to_assign</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="n">MIN_ROUTE_SIZE</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">iterations</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mi">50</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">iterations</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>

                    <span class="c1"># Hard cap: MAX_ROUTES_LIMIT was previously only checked between</span>
                    <span class="c1"># CSV rows, so a single big-demand row could push pending_routes</span>
                    <span class="c1"># well past the limit before anything noticed. Check + clamp here too.</span>
                    <span class="n">remaining_budget</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">MAX_ROUTES_LIMIT</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pending_routes</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">remaining_budget</span> <span class="o">&lt;=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">break</span>

                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">target_jobs</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="c1"># No real job building in this destination grid cell</span>
                        <span class="c1"># at all - nothing to route these commuters to.</span>
                        <span class="n">dropped_commuters</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="n">commuters_to_assign</span>
                        <span class="k">break</span>

                    <span class="n">max_affordable</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">commuters_to_assign</span> <span class="o">//</span> <span class="n">MIN_ROUTE_SIZE</span>
                    <span class="n">num_conn</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">min</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">MAX_HUBS_PER_GRID</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">current_homes</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">max_affordable</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">remaining_budget</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">num_conn</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">break</span>

                    <span class="n">potential_routes</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
                    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">h</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">current_homes</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">j</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">target_jobs</span><span class="p">:</span>
                            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">setdefault</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"connections"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="n">MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_JOB</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">continue</span>
                            <span class="n">dist</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">hypot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mi">111000</span>
                            <span class="n">dist</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dist</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mf">10.0</span><span class="p">)</span>
                            <span class="n">weight</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">h</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"residents"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"jobs"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">))</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dist</span> <span class="o">**</span> <span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span>
                            <span class="n">potential_routes</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">weight</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">))</span>

                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">potential_routes</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="c1"># Every real job building in this grid cell is</span>
                        <span class="c1"># already at MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_JOB - no real</span>
                        <span class="c1"># building left here to route the remainder to.</span>
                        <span class="n">dropped_commuters</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="n">commuters_to_assign</span>
                        <span class="k">break</span>

                    <span class="n">potential_routes</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">sort</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">key</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="k">lambda</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">x</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">reverse</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>

                    <span class="c1"># Pick the top num_conn unique (home, job) pairs, respecting connection caps</span>
                    <span class="n">assigned_pairs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">set</span><span class="p">()</span>
                    <span class="n">selected</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
                    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">weight</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">j</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">potential_routes</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="n">pair_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">id</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">h</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">_</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">id</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">j</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>

                        <span class="c1"># Determine if this job hub is an airport</span>
                        <span class="n">is_airport</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"is_airport"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">)</span>

                        <span class="c1"># Bypass connection limit if it is an airport</span>
                        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">is_airport</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">setdefault</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"connections"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="n">MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_JOB</span><span class="p">:</span>
                            <span class="k">continue</span>

                        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">pair_id</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">assigned_pairs</span><span class="p">:</span>
                            <span class="n">assigned_pairs</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">add</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pair_id</span><span class="p">)</span>
                            <span class="c1"># Only increment connections if it is NOT an airport</span>
                            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">is_airport</span><span class="p">:</span>
                                <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"connections"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>
                            <span class="n">selected</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">((</span><span class="n">weight</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">is_airport</span><span class="p">))</span>

                        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">selected</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="n">num_conn</span><span class="p">:</span>
                            <span class="k">break</span>

                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">selected</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="k">break</span>

                    <span class="c1"># Distribute commuters_to_assign across the selected pairs proportional</span>
                    <span class="c1"># to gravity weight instead of splitting it evenly. An even split made</span>
                    <span class="c1"># every route/pop in a pass come out roughly the same size regardless of</span>
                    <span class="c1"># distance or building size, which is why the demand map looked uniform</span>
                    <span class="c1"># (this was PR feedback: "all pops are roughly the same size").</span>
                    <span class="n">total_weight</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">w</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">w</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">selected</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="n">connections_made</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
                    <span class="n">assigned_commuters</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
                    <span class="n">route_error</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mf">0.0</span>

                    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">weight</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">is_airport</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">selected</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="n">share</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">commuters_to_assign</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">weight</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="n">total_weight</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">total_weight</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span> \
                                <span class="k">else</span> <span class="n">commuters_to_assign</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">selected</span><span class="p">)</span>
                        <span class="n">exact</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">share</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">route_error</span>
                        <span class="n">route_size</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">max</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">MIN_ROUTE_SIZE</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">round</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">exact</span><span class="p">)))</span>
                        <span class="n">route_error</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">exact</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">route_size</span>

                        <span class="n">pop_id</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"pop_</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pending_routes</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">06d</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>
                        <span class="n">pending_routes</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">({</span>
                            <span class="s2">"pop_id"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">pop_id</span><span class="p">,</span>
                            <span class="s2">"h"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">,</span>
                            <span class="s2">"j"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">,</span>
                            <span class="s2">"commuters_per_route"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">route_size</span>
                        <span class="p">})</span>
                        <span class="n">connections_made</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>
                        <span class="n">assigned_commuters</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="n">route_size</span>

                    <span class="n">commuters_to_assign</span> <span class="o">-=</span> <span class="n">assigned_commuters</span>

                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">connections_made</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="k">break</span>

            <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">row</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">reader</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">row</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="mi">3</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">continue</span>
                <span class="n">count</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">row</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">pendler_idx</span><span class="p">])</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">count</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="n">MIN_COMMUTER_THRESHOLD</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">continue</span> 
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pending_routes</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="n">MAX_ROUTES_LIMIT</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">break</span>

                <span class="n">wo</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ao</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">row</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">wo_idx</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">row</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">ao_idx</span><span class="p">]</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">wo</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">grid_homes</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">ao</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">grid_jobs</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">homes_in_cell</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">grid_homes</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">wo</span><span class="p">]</span>
                    <span class="n">jobs_normal</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">grid_jobs</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">ao</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s2">"normal"</span><span class="p">]</span>
                    <span class="n">jobs_special</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">grid_jobs</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">ao</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s2">"special"</span><span class="p">]</span>
                    
                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">homes_in_cell</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">continue</span>
                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">jobs_normal</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">jobs_special</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="k">continue</span>

                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">jobs_special</span> <span class="ow">and</span> <span class="n">jobs_normal</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="n">special_count</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">count</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">SPECIAL_DEMAND_SPLIT</span><span class="p">)</span>
                        <span class="n">normal_count</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">count</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">special_count</span>
                    <span class="k">elif</span> <span class="n">jobs_special</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="n">special_count</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">count</span>
                        <span class="n">normal_count</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
                    <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="n">special_count</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>
                        <span class="n">normal_count</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">count</span>

                    <span class="n">assign_commuters</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">jobs_special</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">special_count</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">homes_in_cell</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ao</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="n">assign_commuters</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">jobs_normal</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">normal_count</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">homes_in_cell</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ao</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OK"</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Prepared </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pending_routes</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> total route queries."</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">total_dropped</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dropped_commuters</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">total_dropped</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  [INFO] </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">total_dropped</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> commuter(s) from the CSV couldn't be assigned to a "</span>
                  <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"real OSM job building and were dropped rather than placed on an invented point "</span>
                  <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"(</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">dropped_commuters</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> in grid cells with no real job building at all, "</span>
                  <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">dropped_commuters</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> where every real job building was already at "</span>
                  <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_JOB=</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">MAX_CONNECTIONS_PER_JOB</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">)."</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Airport snapping + grid mapping + CSV commuter assignment"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">except</span> <span class="ne">FileNotFoundError</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"ERROR"</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">[ERROR] '</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">COMMUTERS_CSV_FILE</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">' not found. Please place it in the root-directory of this script."</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="kc">False</span>

    <span class="c1"># =========================================================</span>
    <span class="c1"># THREADED OSRM FETCHING WITH RETRY ADAPTER &amp; SNAPPING</span>
    <span class="c1"># (base routing only - enrichment now runs in its own function/OSRM</span>
    <span class="c1"># container lifecycle, see enrich_demand() below)</span>
    <span class="c1"># =========================================================</span>
    <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">start_osrm_container</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OSRM container startup (map data prep, cached after the first run)"</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">Resolving precise distances and times via OSRM (</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">OSRM_URL</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">)..."</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="c1"># requests.Session()'s default HTTPAdapter caps its connection pool at</span>
        <span class="c1"># 10 (pool_connections/pool_maxsize), regardless of how many</span>
        <span class="c1"># ThreadPoolExecutor workers try to use it - without mounting a</span>
        <span class="c1"># bigger pool, most threads just queue for one of 10 real</span>
        <span class="c1"># connections instead of genuinely running concurrent requests.</span>
        <span class="c1"># Sized generously (TABLE_MAX_WORKERS is defined further below, at</span>
        <span class="c1"># 30) since a bigger pool than actually needed costs nothing.</span>
        <span class="n">TABLE_POOL_SIZE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">50</span>
        <span class="n">session</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">requests</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">Session</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="n">_adapter</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">requests</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">adapters</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">HTTPAdapter</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pool_connections</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">TABLE_POOL_SIZE</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                                  <span class="n">pool_maxsize</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">TABLE_POOL_SIZE</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">session</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mount</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"http://"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_adapter</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">session</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">mount</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"https://"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">_adapter</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">raw_pops</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

        <span class="c1"># Many pending_routes can share the exact same (home, job) location</span>
        <span class="c1"># pair - assign_commuters()'s while loop can pick the same top-weight</span>
        <span class="c1"># pair across multiple rounds when a single CSV row's commuter count</span>
        <span class="c1"># needs several rounds to fully assign. The driving duration/distance</span>
        <span class="c1"># only depends on the two physical coordinates, never on which pop or</span>
        <span class="c1"># how many commuters ride it - so querying OSRM once per UNIQUE pair</span>
        <span class="c1"># instead of once per pop cuts real HTTP requests with zero change to</span>
        <span class="c1"># the result. Fan-out back to every pop happens after routing below.</span>
        <span class="n">pair_representative</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{}</span>
        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">task</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">pending_routes</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">pair_key</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">task</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"h"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">task</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"j"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">])</span>
            <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">pair_key</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">pair_representative</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">pair_representative</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">pair_key</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">task</span>
        <span class="n">unique_tasks</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">list</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pair_representative</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">values</span><span class="p">())</span>
        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">unique_tasks</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">&lt;</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pending_routes</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pending_routes</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> routes reference only "</span>
                  <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">unique_tasks</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> unique home/job pairs - querying "</span>
                  <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"OSRM once per unique pair instead of once per route."</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="c1"># OSRM's /table endpoint computes a many-to-many duration/distance</span>
        <span class="c1"># MATRIX in one request, instead of /route's one-pair-per-request.</span>
        <span class="c1"># Batching TABLE_BATCH_SIZE pairs' homes as "sources" and jobs as</span>
        <span class="c1"># "destinations" in one call turns that many individual HTTP round</span>
        <span class="c1"># trips into one - we only want the DIAGONAL of the resulting</span>
        <span class="c1"># matrix (source i paired with destination i, i.e. each task's own</span>
        <span class="c1"># h/j), which wastes server-side compute (an NxN matrix to get N</span>
        <span class="c1"># values - at N=40 that's 39x more cells computed than needed) in</span>
        <span class="c1"># exchange for fewer requests.</span>
        <span class="c1">#</span>
        <span class="c1"># This ratio matters because measuring real BER data showed OSRM</span>
        <span class="c1"># genuinely CPU-saturated during routing (94-98% of 16 cores' worth)</span>
        <span class="c1"># - so the wasted cells are now competing for the same scarce</span>
        <span class="c1"># resource as the useful ones, not just filling otherwise-idle</span>
        <span class="c1"># capacity. Measured so far: no batching ~69.6s (all per-request</span>
        <span class="c1"># overhead, no waste) -&gt; batch=40 60.4s (less overhead, lots of</span>
        <span class="c1"># waste) -&gt; batch=10 54.1s (better than both) - since 10 beat both</span>
        <span class="c1"># ends, the real optimum is somewhere in between rather than at</span>
        <span class="c1"># either extreme. Trying 5 next (waste ratio 9x -&gt; 4x) to see which</span>
        <span class="c1"># side of 10 it falls on and narrow in on the actual sweet spot.</span>
        <span class="n">TABLE_BATCH_SIZE</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">5</span>
        <span class="n">TABLE_MAX_WORKERS</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">30</span>

        <span class="n">batches</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">unique_tasks</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">:</span><span class="n">i</span> <span class="o">+</span> <span class="n">TABLE_BATCH_SIZE</span><span class="p">]</span>
                   <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">unique_tasks</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">TABLE_BATCH_SIZE</span><span class="p">)]</span>

        <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">process_table_batch</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">):</span>
            <span class="n">n</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">coords</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">([</span><span class="n">task</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"h"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">task</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">]</span>
                      <span class="o">+</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">task</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"j"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">task</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">])</span>
            <span class="n">coord_str</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">";"</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">lon</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">lat</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">lon</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">lat</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">coords</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">radii_str</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">";"</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">([</span><span class="s2">"1000"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">coords</span><span class="p">))</span>
