            <span class="n">sources</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">";"</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">))</span>
            <span class="n">destinations</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="s2">";"</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">join</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">str</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">range</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">n</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">2</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="n">n</span><span class="p">))</span>
            <span class="n">url</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">OSRM_URL</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">/table/v1/driving/</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">coord_str</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>
                   <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"?sources=</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">sources</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">&amp;destinations=</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">destinations</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>
                   <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"&amp;annotations=duration,distance&amp;radiuses=</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">radii_str</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">)</span>

            <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">response</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">session</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">url</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">timeout</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mf">15.0</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">response</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">status_code</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="mi">200</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{},</span> <span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
                <span class="n">data</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">response</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">json</span><span class="p">()</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"code"</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">!=</span> <span class="s2">"Ok"</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{},</span> <span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
                <span class="n">durations</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"durations"</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="n">distances</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">data</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"distances"</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">durations</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">distances</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{},</span> <span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
            <span class="k">except</span> <span class="n">requests</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">RequestException</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="k">return</span> <span class="p">{},</span> <span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[]</span>

            <span class="n">resolved</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{}</span>
            <span class="n">fallback_tasks</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
            <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">i</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">task</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="nb">enumerate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">):</span>
                <span class="n">pair_key</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="n">task</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"h"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">task</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"j"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">])</span>
                <span class="n">d_sec</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">durations</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">]</span>
                <span class="n">d_dist</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">distances</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="n">i</span><span class="p">]</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">d_sec</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">d_dist</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="c1"># This specific pair has no road route - not a batch-</span>
                    <span class="c1"># level failure, so fall back to straight-line for just</span>
                    <span class="c1"># this pair rather than retrying the whole batch.</span>
                    <span class="n">fallback_tasks</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">task</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">resolved</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">pair_key</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">d_sec</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">d_dist</span><span class="p">))</span>
            <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">resolved</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="p">[],</span> <span class="n">fallback_tasks</span>

        <span class="n">resolved_by_pair</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{}</span>
        <span class="n">pending_batches</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">batches</span>
        <span class="n">attempt</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>

        <span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">_CpuSampler</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"osrm-backend"</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">_cpu_sampler</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="k">while</span> <span class="n">pending_batches</span><span class="p">:</span>
                <span class="n">pending_pairs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">b</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">pending_batches</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">--- OSRM Table Fetch Pass </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">attempt</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> (</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pending_batches</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> "</span>
                      <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"batch(es), ~</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">pending_pairs</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> pairs pending) ---"</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="n">failed_batches</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[]</span>
                <span class="n">completed_pairs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span>

                <span class="k">with</span> <span class="n">ThreadPoolExecutor</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">max_workers</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">TABLE_MAX_WORKERS</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">executor</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="n">futures</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{</span><span class="n">executor</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">submit</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">process_table_batch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">b</span><span class="p">):</span> <span class="n">b</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">b</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">pending_batches</span><span class="p">}</span>

                    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">future</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">as_completed</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">futures</span><span class="p">):</span>
                        <span class="n">resolved</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">retry_batch</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">fallback_tasks</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">future</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">result</span><span class="p">()</span>
                        <span class="n">resolved_by_pair</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">update</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">resolved</span><span class="p">)</span>
                        <span class="n">completed_pairs</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">resolved</span><span class="p">)</span>
                        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">retry_batch</span><span class="p">:</span>
                            <span class="n">failed_batches</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">retry_batch</span><span class="p">)</span>
                        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">task</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">fallback_tasks</span><span class="p">:</span>
                            <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">j</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">task</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"h"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">task</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"j"</span><span class="p">]</span>
                            <span class="n">dist</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">hypot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mi">111000</span>
                            <span class="n">resolved_by_pair</span><span class="p">[(</span><span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">])]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dist</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mf">8.3</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dist</span><span class="p">))</span>

                <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">" -&gt; Resolved </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">completed_pairs</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> pair(s) in this pass."</span><span class="p">)</span>

                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">failed_batches</span><span class="p">:</span>
                    <span class="k">break</span>

                <span class="n">total_failed_pairs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">b</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">b</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">failed_batches</span><span class="p">)</span>
                <span class="k">if</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">failed_batches</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pending_batches</span><span class="p">):</span>
                    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">total_failed_pairs</span> <span class="o">&gt;=</span> <span class="n">OUTAGE_WARNING_MIN_QUEUE</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">[WARNING] All remaining batches failed connection. Container might be down."</span><span class="p">)</span>
                        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Forcing Euclidean math fallback to clear the queue and prevent infinite loop."</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">total_failed_pairs</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> route(s) couldn't be resolved via OSRM after "</span>
                              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"retrying - using straight-line distance for them."</span><span class="p">)</span>
                    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">batch</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">failed_batches</span><span class="p">:</span>
                        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">task</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">batch</span><span class="p">:</span>
                            <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">j</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">task</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"h"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">task</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"j"</span><span class="p">]</span>
                            <span class="n">dist</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">math</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">hypot</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"location"</span><span class="p">][</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="p">])</span> <span class="o">*</span> <span class="mi">111000</span>
                            <span class="n">resolved_by_pair</span><span class="p">[(</span><span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">])]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dist</span> <span class="o">/</span> <span class="mf">8.3</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">dist</span><span class="p">))</span>
                    <span class="k">break</span>

                <span class="n">pending_batches</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">failed_batches</span>
                <span class="n">attempt</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="mi">1</span>

            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">OK - OSRM Routing Complete"</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">_cpu_sampler</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">report</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="nb">int</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">OSRM_THREADS</span><span class="p">))</span>
        <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"OSRM routing of </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pending_routes</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> base commuter routes "</span>
                    <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"(</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">unique_tasks</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> unique pairs, </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">batches</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> table batches)"</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="c1"># Fan each pair's resolved result back out to every pop sharing that</span>
        <span class="c1"># pair - each pop keeps its own id/commuters_per_route, just reusing</span>
        <span class="c1"># the already-resolved duration/distance instead of a second query.</span>
        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">task</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">pending_routes</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">j</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">task</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"h"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">task</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"j"</span><span class="p">]</span>
            <span class="n">seconds</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">distance</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">resolved_by_pair</span><span class="p">[(</span><span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">])]</span>
            <span class="n">raw_pops</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(({</span>
                <span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">task</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"pop_id"</span><span class="p">],</span>
                <span class="s2">"residenceId"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">],</span>
                <span class="s2">"jobId"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">],</span>
                <span class="s2">"drivingSeconds"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">seconds</span><span class="p">,</span>
                <span class="s2">"drivingDistance"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">distance</span>
            <span class="p">},</span> <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">task</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"commuters_per_route"</span><span class="p">]))</span>

        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">Applying strict real-world commuter counts to physical buildings..."</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">" "</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">flush</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">points</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">p</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"is_airport"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">p</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"grids"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">p</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"connections"</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residents"</span><span class="p">],</span> <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobs"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="mi">0</span>

        <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">raw_size</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">raw_pops</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"size"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">raw_size</span>
            <span class="n">pops</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"popIds"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">])</span>
            <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"popIds"</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">append</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">pop</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"id"</span><span class="p">])</span>
            <span class="n">h</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residents"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="n">raw_size</span>
            <span class="n">j</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobs"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">+=</span> <span class="n">raw_size</span>

        <span class="n">active_points</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">p</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">points</span> <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residents"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span> <span class="ow">or</span> <span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobs"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">&gt;</span> <span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">]</span>

        <span class="n">final_pop</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"residents"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">active_points</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">final_jobs</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s2">"jobs"</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">p</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">active_points</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OK"</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Final Real-World Values: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">final_pop</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> residents | </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">final_jobs</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> jobs"</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  -&gt; Normal Jobs: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'jobs'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">for</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">in</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">active_points</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">not</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">p</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'is_special'</span><span class="p">))</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> (in </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">for</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">in</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">active_points</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">not</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">p</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'is_special'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">and</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'jobs'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> hubs)"</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  -&gt; Special Jobs: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'jobs'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">for</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">in</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">active_points</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">p</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'is_special'</span><span class="p">))</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> (in </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="mi">1</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">for</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">p</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">in</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">active_points</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="k">if</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">p</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">get</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s1">'is_special'</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="ow">and</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">p</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'jobs'</span><span class="p">]</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">&gt;</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="mi">0</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> hubs)"</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Total Game Entities: </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">final_pop</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="o">+</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="n">final_jobs</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">makedirs</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dirname</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">BASE_OUTPUT_FILE</span><span class="p">),</span> <span class="n">exist_ok</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Saving base demand to '</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">BASE_OUTPUT_FILE</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">'..."</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">end</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="s2">" "</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">flush</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">True</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">with</span> <span class="nb">open</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">BASE_OUTPUT_FILE</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"w"</span><span class="p">)</span> <span class="k">as</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="n">json</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">dump</span><span class="p">({</span><span class="s2">"points"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">active_points</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="s2">"pops"</span><span class="p">:</span> <span class="n">pops</span><span class="p">},</span> <span class="n">f</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">indent</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="mi">2</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OK"</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Applying commuter counts + saving base demand"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">finally</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">stop_osrm_container</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OSRM container shutdown"</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">total</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">_phase_times</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">values</span><span class="p">())</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">--- Phase timing summary (base stage) ---"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">label</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">secs</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">_phase_times</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">items</span><span class="p">():</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">secs</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">6.1f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">s  (</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">secs</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="n">total</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="mi">100</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">4.1f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">%)  </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">label</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">total</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">6.1f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">s  (100.0%)  TOTAL</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Base demand done!"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="kc">True</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">enrich_demand</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Enrichment stage of the modular pipeline: loads the checkpoint</span>
<span class="sd">    build_base_demand() saved to BASE_OUTPUT_FILE and runs everything after</span>
<span class="sd">    base routing - cluster/consolidate, named special demand, re-routing the</span>
<span class="sd">    new special-demand pops, and the final save to OUTPUT_FILE (the file the</span>
<span class="sd">    rest of the map tooling actually reads). Runs its own independent OSRM</span>
<span class="sd">    container lifecycle and re-detects special demand fresh (cheap once the</span>
<span class="sd">    per-city JSON is already populated - see special_demand_utils.py), so it</span>
<span class="sd">    never needs to touch OSM parsing, airport snapping, or base OSRM routing</span>
<span class="sd">    at all. Use this (via demand()) after only changing RES_SIZE_RATIO/</span>
<span class="sd">    JOB_SIZE_RATIO or hand-editing a special-demand JSON, instead of re-running the full (much</span>
<span class="sd">    slower) base pipeline for no reason. Returns True on success, False if</span>
<span class="sd">    no base checkpoint exists yet to enrich.</span>

<span class="sd">    autofill_special_demand: see build_base_demand()'s docstring - same</span>
<span class="sd">    override/default behavior.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span> <span class="ow">is</span> <span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">_cli_args</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span>

    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">os</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">path</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">exists</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">BASE_OUTPUT_FILE</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">[ERROR] '</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">BASE_OUTPUT_FILE</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">' not found. Run the full "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"pipeline first (`python generate_demand_qzm_local.py` or "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"all()) so there's a base checkpoint to enrich."</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="kc">False</span>

    <span class="n">bbox</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">[</span><span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LON</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MIN_LAT</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LON</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">BBOX_MAX_LAT</span><span class="p">]</span>
    <span class="n">cleaned_opl_path</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">CITY_RAW_DIR</span><span class="si">}{</span><span class="n">OPL_CLEANED_FILE</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span>

    <span class="n">ready_special_demand</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">detect_and_confirm_special_demand</span><span class="p">(</span>
        <span class="n">CITY_CODE</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">RAW_BASE_DIR</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">cleaned_opl_path</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">bbox</span><span class="p">,</span>
        <span class="n">autofill_landmarks</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span><span class="p">,</span>
    <span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">green_polygons</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">_load_green_space_cache</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">GREEN_SPACE_CACHE_FILE</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">green_polygons</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  [WARNING] No green-space polygon cache found at "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"'</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">GREEN_SPACE_CACHE_FILE</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">' - proceeding without green-space "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"placement checks. Run build_base_demand()/all() at least "</span>
              <span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"once to generate it."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">green_index</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">GreenSpaceIndex</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">green_polygons</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">_phase_times</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="p">{}</span>
    <span class="n">_t_phase_start</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">time</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">label</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">nonlocal</span> <span class="n">_t_phase_start</span>
        <span class="n">now</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">time</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">time</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="n">_phase_times</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="n">label</span><span class="p">]</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">now</span> <span class="o">-</span> <span class="n">_t_phase_start</span>
        <span class="n">_t_phase_start</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">now</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">Enriching demand (cluster/consolidate + named special demand)..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="c1"># verb=False: depot's own add_points()/cluster_points()/etc. print</span>
    <span class="c1"># their own internal per-point chatter (e.g. a 2-line "Adding X demand</span>
    <span class="c1"># for Y" block per special demand point) - redundant with our own</span>
    <span class="c1"># summarized progress prints in cluster_and_consolidate()/</span>
    <span class="c1"># add_named_special_demand(), and unreadable at hundreds of points.</span>
    <span class="c1"># print_stats() is unconditional, so you still get the final numbers.</span>
    <span class="n">demand</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="n">DemandData</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">BASE_OUTPUT_FILE</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">CITY_CODE</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">bbox</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">bbox</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">outputdir</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">CITY_RAW_DIR</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">verb</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">False</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"Loaded </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'points'</span><span class="p">])</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> points / </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">[</span><span class="s1">'pops'</span><span class="p">])</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> pops."</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="k">try</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">start_osrm_container</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OSRM container startup (map data prep, cached after the first run)"</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">[1/2] Cleaning up base demand (no external data used here)..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">cluster_and_consolidate</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">green_index</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">green_index</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="n">agglomerate_small_threshold</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">RES_AGGLOMERATE_SMALL_THRESHOLD</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="n">agglomerate_distance_noncbd</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">RES_AGGLOMERATE_DISTANCE_NONCBD</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="n">agglomerate_distance_cbd</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">RES_AGGLOMERATE_DISTANCE_CBD</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="n">res_max_point_size</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">RES_MAX_POINT_SIZE</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="n">job_max_point_size</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">JOB_MAX_POINT_SIZE</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="n">res_cluster_max_pop_threshold</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">RES_CLUSTER_MAX_POP_THRESHOLD</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="n">res_cluster_buffer_meters</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">RES_CLUSTER_BUFFER_METERS</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="n">job_cluster_max_pop_threshold</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">JOB_CLUSTER_MAX_POP_THRESHOLD</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                <span class="n">job_cluster_buffer_meters</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">JOB_CLUSTER_BUFFER_METERS</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"cluster_and_consolidate (merge + agglomerate + cluster_points + caps)"</span><span class="p">)</span>

        <span class="k">if</span> <span class="n">ready_special_demand</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">[2/2] Adding </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ready_special_demand</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> named special demand point(s)..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">add_named_special_demand</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">ready_special_demand</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"add_named_special_demand (</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="nb">len</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">ready_special_demand</span><span class="p">)</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">,</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2"> landmarks)"</span><span class="p">)</span>

            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">Calculating routes for the newly added special demand pops via "</span>
                  <span class="s2">"OSRM..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">route_new_pops</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">OSRM_URL</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"route_new_pops (landmark routes)"</span><span class="p">)</span>

            <span class="c1"># add_points() (inside add_named_special_demand()) generates each</span>
            <span class="c1"># landmark's own commute pops by gravity-sampling FROM already-</span>
            <span class="c1"># existing nearby points - i.e. it adds residents/jobs directly</span>
            <span class="c1"># onto ordinary points that enforce_max_point_size() already</span>
            <span class="c1"># capped during cluster_and_consolidate() above. With 230+</span>
            <span class="c1"># landmarks each doing this, a handful of well-placed ordinary</span>
            <span class="c1"># points can get pushed back over the cap (verified on real BER</span>
            <span class="c1"># data: 434 points still over 2,000 after this, some by 1,000+).</span>
            <span class="c1"># Re-run the same cap here, now that nothing more will add to</span>
            <span class="c1"># these points.</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">Re-capping point sizes inflated by newly added special demand..."</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">enforce_max_point_size</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">demand</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">res_max_point_size</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">RES_MAX_POINT_SIZE</span><span class="p">,</span>
                                   <span class="n">job_max_point_size</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">JOB_MAX_POINT_SIZE</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">green_index</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">green_index</span><span class="p">)</span>
            <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"re-cap point sizes after landmarks"</span><span class="p">)</span>
        <span class="k">else</span><span class="p">:</span>
            <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">[2/2] No named special demand points with capacity data yet - skipping."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">finally</span><span class="p">:</span>
        <span class="n">stop_osrm_container</span><span class="p">()</span>
        <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"OSRM container shutdown"</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">demand</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">print_stats</span><span class="p">()</span>
    <span class="n">demand</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">save</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">OUTPUT_FILE</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">Saved enriched demand to '</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">OUTPUT_FILE</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">'."</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="n">_mark_phase</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"print_stats + save"</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="n">total</span> <span class="o">=</span> <span class="nb">sum</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">_phase_times</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">values</span><span class="p">())</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">--- Phase timing summary (enrichment stage) ---"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">for</span> <span class="n">label</span><span class="p">,</span> <span class="n">secs</span> <span class="ow">in</span> <span class="n">_phase_times</span><span class="o">.</span><span class="n">items</span><span class="p">():</span>
        <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">secs</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">6.1f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">s  (</span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">secs</span><span class="o">/</span><span class="n">total</span><span class="o">*</span><span class="mi">100</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">4.1f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">%)  </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">label</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="sa">f</span><span class="s2">"  </span><span class="si">{</span><span class="n">total</span><span class="si">:</span><span class="s2">6.1f</span><span class="si">}</span><span class="s2">s  (100.0%)  TOTAL</span><span class="se">\n</span><span class="s2">"</span><span class="p">)</span>

    <span class="nb">print</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="s2">"Done!"</span><span class="p">)</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="kc">True</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">all</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Runs the full pipeline end to end: build_base_demand() followed by</span>
<span class="sd">    enrich_demand() - equivalent to the old single-function build_demand(),</span>
<span class="sd">    just split into two independently-runnable/composable stages. Skips</span>
<span class="sd">    enrich_demand() if build_base_demand() hit an early-exit condition (no</span>
<span class="sd">    buildings found, missing commuter CSV, airport hub coordinates still</span>
<span class="sd">    pending manual input in custom_hubs.json).</span>

<span class="sd">    autofill_special_demand: see build_base_demand()'s docstring - forwarded</span>
<span class="sd">    to both stages so the same override applies throughout the whole run.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="k">if</span> <span class="ow">not</span> <span class="n">build_base_demand</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span><span class="p">):</span>
        <span class="k">return</span> <span class="kc">False</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">enrich_demand</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span><span class="p">)</span>


<span class="k">def</span><span class="w"> </span><span class="nf">demand</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="kc">None</span><span class="p">):</span>
<span class="w">    </span><span class="sd">"""</span>
<span class="sd">    Re-runs ONLY the enrichment stage against the existing base checkpoint</span>
<span class="sd">    (BASE_OUTPUT_FILE) - use this after changing RES_SIZE_RATIO/</span>
<span class="sd">    JOB_SIZE_RATIO, hand-editing a special-demand JSON, or tweaking enrich_utils.py, when the raw</span>
<span class="sd">    OSM/routing data hasn't changed and re-running the full (much slower)</span>
<span class="sd">    base pipeline would just reproduce the same base checkpoint.</span>

<span class="sd">    autofill_special_demand: see build_base_demand()'s docstring.</span>
<span class="sd">    """</span>
    <span class="k">return</span> <span class="n">enrich_demand</span><span class="p">(</span><span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span><span class="o">=</span><span class="n">autofill_special_demand</span><span class="p">)</span>


<span class="c1"># Stage selection (choosing all() vs demand()) lives in the wrapper script,</span>
<span class="c1"># run_demand_pipeline.py, not here - see its module comment. Running this</span>
<span class="c1"># file directly still does the full pipeline, same as before the modular</span>
<span class="c1"># split, for anything that already invokes it that way.</span>
<span class="k">if</span> <span class="vm">__name__</span> <span class="o">==</span> <span class="s2">"__main__"</span><span class="p">:</span>
    <span class="nb">all</span><span class="p">()</span>
</pre></div></td></tr></table></div>

      </section>
    </main>
  </div>
</body>
